#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Hosted-only complete nine-body MIR/refinement and optional refusal dump."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]


def load(path: Path, name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"missing capture module: {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


PREP = load(HERE / "prepare.py", "nine_body_source")
GUARD = load(HERE.parent / "overnight-guard-actual" /
             "capture-actual-nested-drop.py", "nine_body_guard_capture")
LINK = GUARD.LINK
MIR = GUARD.CAPTURE.A1
DIAGNOSTIC_TEXT = (
    "SORT4-ACTUAL-NESTED-FINGERPRINT: diagnostic refusal: "
    "snapshot complete; no proof rule admitted"
)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def clear_semantic_opt_ins() -> None:
    for key in (
        "SORT4_MAYBEUNINIT_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_SELECT_INTRINSIC_REPO_ROOT",
        "SORT4_POINTER_DROP_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_GUARD_REPO_ROOT",
        "SORT4_GUARD_TEMPLATE_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_ACTUAL_OWNER_REPO_ROOT",
        "SORT4_ACTUAL_OWNER_ADMISSION", "SORT4_ACTUAL_FORGET_REPO_ROOT",
        "SORT4_A1_LINK_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_G1_CALL_REPO_ROOT",
        "SORT4_STRICT_LFT_CUT", "SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT",
        "SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT_TARGETS", "SORT4_NESTED_FINGERPRINT_MODE",
        "SORT4_NESTED_FINGERPRINT_EVIDENCE_DIR",
        "SORT4_NESTED_FINGERPRINT_SOURCE_SHA256",
    ):
        os.environ.pop(key, None)


def full_body_capture(case: Path, source: dict, stages: dict) -> dict:
    expected = source["source_order"]
    result = {}
    for mode in ("normal", "readonly"):
        if stages.get(f"{mode}-decode", {}).get("exit") != 0:
            result[mode] = {"classification": "DECODE_UNAVAILABLE"}
            continue
        decoded = (case / f"{mode}-mir.txt").read_text(errors="strict")
        rows = []
        offsets = []
        for index, name in enumerate(expected):
            marker = f'defPath = "{name}"'
            PREP.require(decoded.count(marker) == 1,
                         f"{mode}: nine-body DefPath absent/duplicate: {name}")
            offsets.append(decoded.index(marker))
            actual_name, body = MIR.complete_function_record(decoded, name)
            PREP.require(actual_name == name and body,
                         f"{mode}: complete body identity mismatch: {name}")
            path = case / f"{mode}-body-{index}-full-mir.txt"
            path.write_text(body)
            rows.append({"index": index, "defpath": actual_name,
                         "file": path.name, "bytes": len(body.encode()),
                         "sha256": sha(body.encode())})
        PREP.require(offsets == sorted(offsets),
                     f"{mode}: nine-body source/MIR order changed")
        result[mode] = {
            "classification": "COMPLETE_NINE_BODY_CAPTURE_ONLY",
            "whole_decoded_mir_file": f"{mode}-mir.txt",
            "whole_decoded_mir_sha256": sha(decoded.encode()),
            "exact_body_count_and_order": True,
            "bodies": rows,
        }
    return result


def refusal_fingerprint(case: Path, source: dict, args) -> dict:
    os.environ["SORT4_NESTED_FINGERPRINT_MODE"] = "9"
    os.environ["SORT4_NESTED_FINGERPRINT_EVIDENCE_DIR"] = str(case.resolve())
    os.environ["SORT4_NESTED_FINGERPRINT_SOURCE_SHA256"] = \
        source["verified_sha256"]
    try:
        stage = LINK.stage(case, "nine-body-fingerprint-refusal", [
            str(args.tool_home / "bin/verifast"), "-rustc_args",
            "--edition 2021", "-verbose", "1", "verified/lib.rs"],
            args, gates=False, pointer_drop=False, cap_seconds=100)
    finally:
        clear_semantic_opt_ins()
    log_path = case / "nine-body-fingerprint-refusal.log"
    log = log_path.read_text(errors="replace") if log_path.is_file() else ""
    snapshots = {}
    for label in ("unit", *(f"body-{index}" for index in range(9))):
        path = case / f"actual-nested-9-{label}.marshal"
        data = path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None
        snapshots[label] = {
            "file": path.name,
            "bytes": len(data) if data is not None else None,
            "sha256": sha(data) if data is not None else None,
        }
    intended = (stage.get("exit") == 2 and
                stage.get("source_unchanged") is True and
                DIAGNOSTIC_TEXT in log and
                not LINK.LINK.ERR.findall(log) and
                all(item["bytes"] is not None and item["bytes"] > 0
                    for item in snapshots.values()))
    return {
        "classification": "INTENDED_DIAGNOSTIC_REFUSAL_NO_PROOF_RULE"
            if intended else "INCONCLUSIVE_FINGERPRINT",
        "stage": stage,
        "expected_refusal_seen": DIAGNOSTIC_TEXT in log,
        "all_ten_snapshots": all(item["bytes"] is not None and
                                 item["bytes"] > 0
                                 for item in snapshots.values()),
        "snapshots": snapshots,
        "body_proof_run": False,
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sysroot", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--fingerprint", action="store_true",
                        help="diagnostic refusal dump only, after paired MIR/refinement")
    source_modes = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    source_modes.add_argument("--wrapper-rebase", action="store_true",
                              help="separate source-only wrapper-owner ghost candidate")
    source_modes.add_argument("--wrapper-input-relation", action="store_true",
                              help="separate source-only selected-input equality diagnostic")
    source_modes.add_argument("--wrapper-input-relation-frame", action="store_true",
                              help="source-only thread-token frame candidate; never enables a proof rule")
    source_modes.add_argument("--wrapper-input-relation-frame-shadow", action="store_true",
                              help="source-only late FRAME ghost-name capture; no proof rule")
    source_modes.add_argument("--wrapper-input-relation-shadow", action="store_true",
                              help="blocked source-only shadow-binding revision diagnostic")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    PREP.require((os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS"),
                  os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT"),
                  os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS")) ==
                 ("true", "github-hosted", "Linux"),
                 "nine-body capture requires GitHub-hosted Linux")
    evidence = args.evidence.resolve()
    clear_semantic_opt_ins()
    if args.wrapper_input_relation_frame_shadow:
        preparer = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-input-relation-frame-shadow.py",
                        "nine_body_wrapper_input_relation_frame_shadow_source")
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation_shadow:
        for key in ("SORT4_WRAPPER_REBASE_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_WRAPPER_REBASE_ADMISSION",
                    "SORT4_WRAPPER_INPUT_RELATION_REPO_ROOT",
                    "SORT4_WRAPPER_INPUT_RELATION_ADMISSION"):
            os.environ.pop(key, None)
        preparer = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-input-relation-shadow.py",
                        "nine_body_wrapper_input_relation_shadow_source")
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation:
        preparer = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-input-relation.py",
                        "nine_body_wrapper_input_relation_source")
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation_frame:
        preparer = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-input-relation-frame.py",
                        "nine_body_wrapper_input_relation_frame_source")
    elif args.wrapper_rebase:
        preparer = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-rebase.py",
                        "nine_body_wrapper_rebase_source")
    else:
        preparer = PREP
    source = preparer.write_case(REPO, evidence)
    case = evidence / preparer.CASE_NAME
    args.first_barrier = False
    args.fingerprint_probe = False
    guard = GUARD.capture_case(case, source, args)
    stages = guard["stages"]
    full = full_body_capture(case, source, stages)
    complete = (guard["frontend_refinement"] is True and
                all(row.get("exact_body_count_and_order") is True
                    for row in full.values()) and
                source["ghost_strip_identity"] is True and
                sha((case / "original/lib.rs").read_bytes()) ==
                    source["original_sha256"] and
                sha((case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes()) ==
                    source["verified_sha256"])
    fingerprint = None
    if args.fingerprint and complete:
        fingerprint = refusal_fingerprint(case, source, args)
    record = {
        "classification": "NINE_BODY_SOURCE_MIR_CALIBRATION_ONLY" if complete
            else "INCONCLUSIVE_NINE_BODY_CAPTURE",
        "source": source,
        "frontend_refinement_and_full_body_capture": complete,
        "full_body_capture": full,
        "guard_capture": guard,
        "fingerprint": fingerprint,
        "actual_helper_proved": False,
        "actual_safe_forget_linked": False,
        "a1_nine_body_admission": False,
        "semantic_rule_enabled": False,
    }
    if args.wrapper_rebase:
        record["source_mode"] = "wrapper-rebase-source-only"
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation:
        record["source_mode"] = "wrapper-input-relation-source-only"
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation_frame:
        record["source_mode"] = "wrapper-input-relation-frame-source-only"
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation_frame_shadow:
        record["source_mode"] = "wrapper-input-relation-frame-shadow-source-only"
    elif args.wrapper_input_relation_shadow:
        record["source_mode"] = "wrapper-input-relation-shadow-source-only"
    (evidence / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"classification": record["classification"],
                      "source_sha256": source["verified_sha256"],
                      "frontend_refinement_and_full_body_capture": complete,
                      "fingerprint": fingerprint["classification"]
                          if fingerprint else None}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Cloud-only late ghost-name revision of the exact FRAME source candidate."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]
CASE_NAME = "nine-body-wrapper-input-relation-frame-shadow"
PROFILE = HERE / "O26-WRAPPER-INPUT-RELATION-FRAME-SHADOW-SOURCE.json"
FRAME_SOURCE = "8543e99940897e3289f9f57fe3edc30fa4cffbba713b68aab36eb49d3faac816"
ORIGINAL = "466882d74de217766ed8d5c583596c173df47f0e6bd40da7cb1a4c931d7265a5"
FRAME_PROFILE = HERE / "O26-R3-FRAME-TEST.json"
FRAME_TRANSLATOR = "a8421aac6bc2863e6df8d5ca9fc94b15251123f5203cf92d271529a595bad243"
OBSERVED_BINDINGS = {
    "normal": {
        "true_val": {"input": "_2", "wrapper": "_6", "input_span": [137, 4, 12],
                     "wrapper_span": [155, 154, 166]},
        "false_val": {"input": "_3", "wrapper": "_8", "input_span": [138, 4, 13],
                      "wrapper_span": [156, 8, 21]},
    },
    "readonly": {
        "true_val": {"input": "_2", "wrapper": "_4", "input_span": [137, 4, 12],
                     "wrapper_span": [155, 90, 102]},
        "false_val": {"input": "_3", "wrapper": "_6", "input_span": [138, 4, 13],
                      "wrapper_span": [156, 8, 21]},
    },
}


def need(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(why)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def load(path: Path, name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    need(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, f"missing FRAME source dependency: {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def reviewed_bindings() -> tuple[dict, dict[str, str]]:
    profile = json.loads(PROFILE.read_text())
    parent_profile = json.loads(FRAME_PROFILE.read_text())
    normal = profile.get("reviewed_normal_shadow_internal_names")
    readonly = profile.get("reviewed_readonly_shadow_internal_names")
    exact = {"true_val": "true_val_1", "false_val": "false_val_1"}
    need(profile.get("status") == "REVIEWED_SOURCE_ONLY_FRAME_SHADOW_BINDING" and
         profile.get("verification_accepted") is False and profile.get("accepted") is False and
         profile.get("parent_verified_sha256") == FRAME_SOURCE and
         profile.get("original_sha256") == ORIGINAL and
         profile.get("parent_case") == "nine-body-wrapper-input-relation-frame" and
         profile.get("parent_translator_sha256") == FRAME_TRANSLATOR and
         profile.get("observed_bindings") == OBSERVED_BINDINGS and
         profile.get("runtime_unchanged") is True and
         profile.get("target_posts_unchanged") is True and
         parent_profile.get("classification") == "EXPERIMENTAL_O26_R3_FRAME_TEST_NOT_ACCEPTED" and
         parent_profile.get("test_translator_sha256") == FRAME_TRANSLATOR and
         parent_profile.get("source", {}).get("verified_sha256") == FRAME_SOURCE and
         parent_profile.get("source", {}).get("original_sha256") == ORIGINAL and
         normal == readonly == exact,
         "FRAME-shadow capture pins or observed NORMAL/readonly bindings differ")
    return profile, exact


def late_comments(frame, names: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, bytes], tuple]:
    old = dict(frame.INPUT.FINAL_ASSERTIONS)
    expected = {"current_true_wrapper_matches_input", "current_false_wrapper_matches_input",
                "shadow_true_wrapper_matches_input", "shadow_false_wrapper_matches_input",
                "conditional_wrapper_matches_input"}
    need(set(old) == expected, "FRAME parent final ghost assertion inventory changed")
    true_name, false_name = names["true_val"].encode(), names["false_val"].encode()
    changed = {
        "shadow_true_wrapper_matches_input": old["shadow_true_wrapper_matches_input"].replace(
            b"inner(true_val)", b"inner(" + true_name + b")"),
        "shadow_false_wrapper_matches_input": old["shadow_false_wrapper_matches_input"].replace(
            b"inner(false_val)", b"inner(" + false_name + b")"),
        "conditional_wrapper_matches_input": old["conditional_wrapper_matches_input"].replace(
            b"{ true_val }", b"{ " + true_name + b" }").replace(
            b"{ false_val }", b"{ " + false_name + b" }"),
    }
    need(all(changed[key] != old[key] and changed[key].count(b"/*@") == 1 and
             changed[key].count(b"@*/") == 1 and changed[key].endswith(b"@*/\n")
             for key in changed) and
         old["shadow_true_wrapper_matches_input"].count(b"inner(true_val)") == 1 and
         old["shadow_false_wrapper_matches_input"].count(b"inner(false_val)") == 1 and
         old["conditional_wrapper_matches_input"].count(b"{ true_val }") == 1 and
         old["conditional_wrapper_matches_input"].count(b"{ false_val }") == 1,
         "exact three late FRAME ghost substitutions differ")
    regions = tuple((region, tuple((name, changed.get(name, comment))
                                  for name, comment in commands))
                    for region, commands in frame.INPUT.REGIONS)
    need(len(regions) == 3 and sum(len(rows) for _, rows in regions) == 9,
         "FRAME source command inventory changed")
    return changed, regions


def write_case(repo: Path, out: Path) -> dict:
    profile, names = reviewed_bindings()
    frame = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-input-relation-frame.py", "frame_shadow_parent")
    need(repo.resolve() == REPO.resolve() and not out.exists(),
         "FRAME-shadow repository/evidence identity changed")
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    parent_root = out / "parent-frame-source"
    parent_record = frame.write_case(repo, parent_root)
    parent_case = parent_root / frame.CASE_NAME
    before = (parent_case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    original = (parent_case / "original/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    need(sha(before) == parent_record.get("verified_sha256") == FRAME_SOURCE and
         sha(original) == parent_record.get("original_sha256") == ORIGINAL and
         parent_record.get("ghost_strip_identity") is True and
         parent_record.get("classification") ==
             "SOURCE_ONLY_THREADONLY_FRAME_CAPTURE_NOT_ACCEPTED" and
         parent_record.get("actual_runtime_unchanged") is True,
         "exact FRAME parent source pair or runtime certificate differs")

    changed, regions = late_comments(frame, names)
    old = dict(frame.INPUT.FINAL_ASSERTIONS)
    after = before
    for name in changed:
        need(after.count(old[name]) == 1 and after.count(changed[name]) == 0,
             f"{name}: parent/revised comment occurrence differs")
        after = after.replace(old[name], changed[name], 1)
    restored = after
    for name in changed:
        restored = restored.replace(changed[name], old[name], 1)
    strip = frame.OWNER.strip_ghost
    need(after != before and restored == before and strip(after) == original and
         sha(original) == ORIGINAL and
         before.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") ==
             after.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") == 3 and
         before.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") ==
             after.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1 and
         before.count(b".assume_init()") == after.count(b".assume_init()") == 1,
         "FRAME-shadow revision changed runtime or comments outside the exact three substitutions")

    comment_rows, region_rows = [], []
    for index, (region_name, commands) in enumerate(regions):
        region = b"".join(comment for _, comment in commands)
        region_rows.append({"index": index, "name": region_name,
                            **frame.source_span(after, region)})
        for name, comment in commands:
            comment_rows.append({"index": len(comment_rows), "name": name,
                "region": region_name, "utf8": comment.decode(),
                **frame.source_span(after, comment)})
    need(len(comment_rows) == 9 and len(region_rows) == 3 and
         [row["byte_start"] for row in comment_rows] ==
             sorted(row["byte_start"] for row in comment_rows),
         "FRAME-shadow ghost comments are not a complete ordered nine-command source record")

    case = out / CASE_NAME
    (case / "verified").mkdir(parents=True)
    (case / "original").mkdir()
    (case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(after)
    (case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    record = {
        "classification": "SOURCE_ONLY_FRAME_SHADOW_CAPTURE_NOT_ACCEPTED",
        "case_name": CASE_NAME,
        "parent_case": str(parent_case.relative_to(out)),
        "parent_verified_sha256": FRAME_SOURCE,
        "verified_sha256": sha(after),
        "original_sha256": sha(original),
        "ghost_strip_identity": strip(after) == original,
        "source_order": parent_record["source_order"],
        "parent_verified_source_transform": parent_record,
        "inserted_ghost_regions": region_rows,
        "inserted_ghost_comments": comment_rows,
        "changed_late_comment_names": sorted(changed),
        "shadow_internal_names": names,
        "verified_source_reversible_three_late_comment_substitutions": True,
        "actual_runtime_unchanged": True,
        "full_mir_refinement_and_proof": "NOT_RUN",
        "semantic_frontend_enabled": False,
        "verification_accepted": False,
        "accepted": False,
    }
    for path in (case / "fixture.json", out / "source-summary.json"):
        path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(write_case(args.repo, args.out), indent=2, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Hosted source-only THREADONLY frame candidate; no proof rule is enabled."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]
CASE_NAME = "nine-body-wrapper-input-relation-frame"
PARENT_SHA256 = "a95aff14592b167c62c53c7ed726128ee86c7c19768cfe613504cdec841f8463"
R2_PARENT_SHA256 = "11067f06ba7c745cfb221a559fb29778eba8d7b6e65f6db1a814ff7ce72bdfd4"
ORIGINAL_SHA256 = "466882d74de217766ed8d5c583596c173df47f0e6bd40da7cb1a4c931d7265a5"


def load(path: Path, name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"missing frame source dependency: {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


INPUT = load(HERE / "prepare-wrapper-input-relation.py",
             "o26_wrapper_input_relation_for_frame")
OWNER = INPUT.R2.BASE.SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER
FORGET = INPUT.R2.BASE.SEVEN.FORGET


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


SAVED_GUARD = (
    b"        /*@ assert <select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic<*Element>>.own(t, ?saved_guard); @*/\n"
)
RETURNED_GUARD = (
    b"        /*@ open <select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic<*Element>>.own(t, saved_guard); @*/\n"
    b"        /*@ assert *saved_guard.inner |-> ?selected_payload; @*/\n"
    b"        /*@ open raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(t, selected_payload); @*/\n"
)
GUARD_CREATE = b"        let guard = DropOnPanic { inner: guard };\n"
DROP_CALL = b"        drop.drop_in_place();\n"
FORGET_CALL = b"        crate::mem::forget(guard);\n"

REMOVALS = (
    ("outer_guard_owner_branch_fold", OWNER.CLOSE_OWNER_LITERAL,
     DROP_CALL, "before"),
    ("saved_guard_owner_assertion", SAVED_GUARD,
     FORGET_CALL, "before"),
    ("post_forget_guard_owner_payload_projection", RETURNED_GUARD,
     FORGET_CALL, "after"),
)


def source_span(source: bytes, fragment: bytes) -> dict:
    start = source.index(fragment)
    end = start + len(fragment)
    line_start = source.rfind(b"\n", 0, start) + 1
    end_line_start = source.rfind(b"\n", 0, end) + 1
    return {"byte_start": start, "byte_end_exclusive": end,
            "line_start_one_based": source.count(b"\n", 0, start) + 1,
            "column_start_zero_based": start - line_start,
            "line_end_one_based": source.count(b"\n", 0, end) + 1,
            "column_end_zero_based": end - end_line_start,
            "bytes": len(fragment), "sha256": sha(fragment)}


def forget_contracts() -> tuple[bytes, bytes, bytes, bytes]:
    signature = b"pub unsafe fn checked_forget_owned<T>(t: T)\n"
    body = b"{\n    let _ = ManuallyDrop::new(t);\n}"
    old = (b"/*@\nreq thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread &*& <T>.own(tid, t);\n@*/\n"
           b"/*@\nens thread_token(tid) &*& <T>.own(tid, t);\n@*/\n"
           b"/*@\non_unwind_ens false;\n@*/\n")
    new = (b"/*@\nreq thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread;\n@*/\n"
           b"/*@\nens thread_token(tid);\n@*/\n"
           b"/*@\non_unwind_ens false;\n@*/\n")
    FORGET.SOURCE.require(
        body == FORGET.SOURCE.FORGET_BODY,
        "exact same-body SAFE forget helper contract/body changed")
