    assume_marker = b"pub unsafe fn " + A1.ADAPTER_NAME.encode()
    require(verified.count(transmute_marker) ==
            verified.count(assume_marker) == 1 and
            verified.index(transmute_marker) < verified.index(assume_marker),
            "A1 local adapter pair missing or reordered")
    pair = verified[verified.index(transmute_marker):].rstrip() + b"\n\n"
    require(pair.count(b"transmute_unchecked(src)") == 1 and
            pair.count(b"transmute_neo(storage)") == 1 and
            pair.count(transmute_marker) == pair.count(assume_marker) == 1,
            "A1 exact source body or call inventory changed")
    return pair, record


def write_case(repo: Path, out: Path) -> dict:
    require((os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS"),
             os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT"),
             os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS")) ==
            ("true", "github-hosted", "Linux"),
            "nine-body preparation requires GitHub-hosted Linux")
    require(repo.resolve() == REPO.resolve() and not out.exists(),
            "nine-body repository/evidence identity changed")
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    seven_out = out / "seven-body-source"
    seven_record = SEVEN.write_case(repo, seven_out, with_owned_forget=True)
    seven_case = seven_out / "seven-body-owned-forget"
    seven_verified = (seven_case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    seven_original = (seven_case / "original/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    pair, a1_record = a1_pair(repo)
    actual_marker = SEVEN.ACTUAL_MARKER
    insert_marker = SEVEN.FORGET_MARKER
    require(seven_verified.count(OLD_FEATURE) == 1 and
            seven_verified.count(NEW_FEATURE) == 0 and
            seven_verified.count(OLD_IMPORT) == 1 and
            seven_verified.count(NEW_IMPORT) == 0 and
            seven_verified.count(insert_marker) == 1 and
            seven_verified.count(actual_marker) == 1 and
            seven_verified.index(insert_marker) <
                seven_verified.index(actual_marker) and
            all(seven_verified.count(name.encode()) == 0 for name in
                (A1.TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME, A1.ADAPTER_NAME)),
            "seven-body import, feature, or insertion boundary changed")
    verified = seven_verified.replace(OLD_FEATURE, NEW_FEATURE, 1)
    verified = verified.replace(OLD_IMPORT, OLD_IMPORT + NEW_IMPORT, 1)
    verified = verified.replace(insert_marker, pair + insert_marker, 1)
    original = SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(verified)
    actual_body, actual_cert = SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER.ACTUAL.source_certificate(repo)
    require(SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(seven_verified) == seven_original and
            original.count(actual_body) == seven_original.count(actual_body) == 1 and
            verified[verified.index(actual_marker):] ==
                seven_verified[seven_verified.index(actual_marker):] and
            original[original.index(actual_marker):] ==
                seven_original[seven_original.index(actual_marker):] and
            verified.count(b"safety_proof {") == 1 and
            verified.count(SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER.OWNER_PRED) == 1 and
            verified.count(SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER.NESTED_DROP_GHOST) == 1 and
            verified.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1 and
            verified.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") == 3 and
            all(verified.count((b"pub unsafe fn " + name.encode())) == 1
                for name in (A1.TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME, A1.ADAPTER_NAME)),
            "nine-body source changed actual runtime or guard protocol")
    case = out / CASE_NAME
    (case / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (case / "verified").mkdir()
    (case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {
        "classification": "SOURCE_ONLY_NINE_BODY_A1_ACTUAL_CAPTURE",
        "source_order": list(ORDER),
        "original_sha256": sha(original),
        "verified_sha256": sha(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": SEVEN.OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(verified) == original,
        "actual_helper_suffix_exact_seven_body": True,
        "actual_helper_body_exact_std": True,
        "actual_helper_proved": False,
        "actual_safe_forget_linked": False,
        "a1_linkage_admitted_in_nine_body": False,
        "semantic_frontend_enabled": False,
        "a1_pair_sha256": sha(pair),
        "a1_linkage_source_certificate": a1_record,
        "seven_body_source_certificate":
            seven_record["owned_forget_seven_body"],
        "actual_source_certificate": actual_cert,
    }
    (case / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    (out / "source-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(write_case(args.repo, args.out),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hosted-only, fail-closed source preparation for the first actual sort4 call.

This does not run a verifier or activate the proposed frontend cut. The
result is a calibration fixture, never an accepted sort4 proof.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent / "overnight-sort4"))
import capture as sort4_capture  # noqa: E402 - the pinned project-owned source extractor
import probe  # noqa: E402


FIRST_CALL = b"        let c1 = is_less(&*v_base.add(1), &*v_base);"
ANNOTATED_FIRST_CALL = (
    b"        let c1 = is_less/*@::<F, (&'cmp T, &'cmp T), 'cmp>@*/"
    b"(&*v_base.add(1), &*v_base);"
)
UNSAFE_ANCHOR = sort4_capture.BORROW_PREFIX_UNSAFE_ANCHOR
CUT = b"        //@ end_lft_binding::<'cmp>();\n"
MARKER = b"""/*@ {
            __vf_sort4_first_unwind();
            { close comparison_debt::<T>(t, cmp_k, v_base + 1, v_base, left_ref, right_ref, left_fraction, right_fraction); }
            { recover_pair::<T>(v_base + 1, v_base); }
            { join_four_owned_cells::<T>(v_base, t); }
        } @*/
"""
NORMAL_AFTER_CALL = b"""
        //@ close comparison_debt::<T>(t, cmp_k, v_base + 1, v_base, left_ref, right_ref, left_fraction, right_fraction);
        //@ end_lft_binding::<'cmp>();
        //@ recover_pair::<T>(v_base + 1, v_base);
        //@ join_four_owned_cells::<T>(v_base, t);"""


def need(ok: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(reason)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def hosted_only() -> None:
    need(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
         os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted" and
         os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS") == "Linux",
         "sort4 first-call preparation requires GitHub-hosted Linux")


def callback_ghost_prefix() -> bytes:
    template = (HERE / "callback-cases.rs").read_bytes()
    begin = b"/*@\npred comparison_debt<T>("
    end = b"// CASE_BEGIN callback_positive\n"
    need(template.count(begin) == template.count(end) == 1,
         "checked callback debt/recovery prefix is missing or ambiguous")
    prefix = template[template.index(begin):template.index(end)]
    need(prefix.count(b"lem recover_pair<T>(") == 1 and
         b"nonghost_callers_only" in prefix and
         prefix.count(b"end_lifetime(k);") == 1,
         "checked callback recovery lemma shape changed")
    # The standalone callback file separates its two ghost declarations and
    # the following case with blank lines.  The std source fixture has no
    # corresponding executable blank lines.  Keep one newline after each
    # @*/ so the shared strip_ghost removes the entire proof-only prefix.
    separator = b"@*/\n\n/*@"
    need(prefix.count(b"/*@") == 2 and prefix.count(separator) == 1 and
         prefix.endswith(b"@*/\n\n"),
         "checked callback ghost-only separators changed")
    prefix = prefix.replace(separator, b"@*/\n/*@", 1)[:-1]
    need(sort4_capture.strip_ghost(prefix) == b"",
         "checked callback prefix leaves executable whitespace")
    return prefix


def save_source_mismatch(output: Path, verified: bytes, stripped: bytes,
                         expected: bytes) -> None:
    """Keep the exact failed source pair for hosted preflight review."""
    mismatch = next((i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(stripped, expected))
                     if a != b), min(len(stripped), len(expected)))
    start = max(0, mismatch - 32)
    end = mismatch + 33
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    (output / "verified-candidate.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    (output / "stripped-candidate.rs").write_bytes(stripped)
    (output / "expected-original.rs").write_bytes(expected)
    (output / "first-source-mismatch.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "classification": "SOURCE_PREFLIGHT_MISMATCH_NO_EXPORT",
        "first_byte_offset": mismatch,
        "expected_byte": expected[mismatch] if mismatch < len(expected) else None,
        "stripped_byte": stripped[mismatch] if mismatch < len(stripped) else None,
        "expected_line": expected[:mismatch].count(b"\n") + 1,
        "stripped_line": stripped[:mismatch].count(b"\n") + 1,
        "expected_window_hex": expected[start:end].hex(),
        "stripped_window_hex": stripped[start:end].hex(),
        "expected_length": len(expected),
        "stripped_length": len(stripped),
        "expected_sha256": sha(expected),
        "stripped_sha256": sha(stripped),
        "verified_candidate_sha256": sha(verified),
    }, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def prepare(repo: Path, output: Path) -> dict:
    need(not output.exists(), "refusing to overwrite existing first-call fixture")
    source = (repo / sort4_capture.SOURCE_REL).read_bytes()
    target, source_certificate = sort4_capture.source_certificate(repo, source)
    need(target.count(FIRST_CALL) == 1 and
         target.count(UNSAFE_ANCHOR) == 1,
         "first actual call or enclosing unsafe scope is ambiguous")
    need(target.count(b"let c2 = is_less(") == 1 and
         target.index(FIRST_CALL) < target.index(b"let c2 = is_less("),
         "first and second comparator order changed")
    need(MARKER.count(b"__vf_sort4_first_unwind();") == 1 and
         NORMAL_AFTER_CALL.count(CUT) == 1,
         "source-written unwind/cut marker inventory changed")

    need(sort4_capture.BORROW_PREFIX_FIRST_CALL.count(ANNOTATED_FIRST_CALL) == 1,
         "source-pinned borrow prefix has no unique annotated first call")
    annotated_call = (sort4_capture.BORROW_PREFIX_FIRST_CALL.replace(
        ANNOTATED_FIRST_CALL, MARKER + ANNOTATED_FIRST_CALL, 1) +
        NORMAL_AFTER_CALL)
    need(annotated_call.count(ANNOTATED_FIRST_CALL) == 1,
         "first-call borrow preparation changed the annotated call")
    verified_target = target.replace(FIRST_CALL, annotated_call, 1)
    verified_target = verified_target.replace(
        UNSAFE_ANCHOR, sort4_capture.BORROW_PREFIX_LIFETIME_SCOPE, 1)
    brace = verified_target.index(b"{")
    debt_and_recovery = callback_ghost_prefix()
    join = (HERE / "join-four-owned-cells.rs").read_bytes()
    need(join.startswith(b"/*@\nlem join_four_owned_cells<T>(") and
         join.rstrip().endswith(b"@*/") and
         b"assume(" not in join and b"assume_correct" not in join,
         "checked join-four lemma source changed shape")
    verified = (sort4_capture.PREFIX + sort4_capture.MEMORY_PRE_INTERIOR_LEMMA +
                sort4_capture.BORROW_PREFIX_SPLIT_LEMMA + debt_and_recovery +
                join + verified_target[:brace] +
                sort4_capture.MEMORY_PRE_CONTRACT + verified_target[brace:])
    original = sort4_capture.strip_ghost(verified)
    expected_original = sort4_capture.PREFIX + target
    if original != expected_original:
        save_source_mismatch(output, verified, original, expected_original)
    need(original == expected_original,
         "ghost stripping failed to recover exact full sort4 runtime body")
    need(original.count(target) == 1 and
         verified.count(ANNOTATED_FIRST_CALL) == 1 and
         verified.count(b"let c2 = is_less(") == 1 and
         verified.count(CUT) == 1 and
         verified.count(b"__vf_sort4_first_unwind();") == 1,
         "first-call source marker or full runtime inventory changed")

    (output / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (output / "verified").mkdir()
    (output / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (output / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {
        "classification": "CALIBRATION_ONLY_FIRST_ACTUAL_CALL_UNADMITTED",
        "actual_sort4_proved": False,
        "semantic_frontend_enabled": False,
        "full_runtime_body_unchanged": True,
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
        "source_certificate": source_certificate,
        "original_sha256": sha(original),
        "verified_sha256": sha(verified),
        "debt_recovery_source_sha256": sha(debt_and_recovery),
        "join_four_source_sha256": sha(join),
        "first_call_source": FIRST_CALL.decode(),
        "marker_count": 1,
        "strict_lifetime_cut_count": 1,
        "expected_full_typed_mir_inventory": {
            "FnMut_call_mut": 5,
            "select_unpredictable": 8,
            "copy_nonoverlapping": 4,
            "first_call_ordered_source_cells": [1, 0],
            "first_call_unwind": "Continue",
            "first_call_cleanup": False,
        },
        "admission": {
            "paired_complete_typed_mir": "PENDING_HOSTED_CALIBRATION",
            "first_call_operand_alias_and_provenance": "PENDING_REVIEW",
            "all_source_mir_cleanup_edges": "PENDING_REVIEW",
            "strict_lifetime_kernel": "PENDING_HOSTED_GATES",
            "first_call_frontend_overlay": "NOT_IMPLEMENTED",
            "full_normal_sort4_post": "NOT_PROVED",
            "full_unwind_sort4_post": "NOT_PROVED",
        },
    }
    (output / "fixture.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def capture_calibration(args: argparse.Namespace, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Export and refine only; deliberately omit full verifier invocation."""
    tool_home = args.tool_home.resolve()
    schema = args.schema.resolve()
    source_checkout = args.source_checkout.resolve()
    need(tool_home.is_dir() and schema.is_file() and source_checkout.is_dir(),
         "pinned hosted tool/schema/source checkout is missing")
    profile = probe.source_certificate(args.repo_root.resolve(),
                                       source_checkout, tool_home)
    fixture = args.output.resolve()
    hashes = {"original/lib.rs": record["original_sha256"],
              "verified/lib.rs": record["verified_sha256"]}
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment["PATH"] = (str(tool_home / "bin") + os.pathsep +
                           environment.get("PATH", ""))
    for key in ("SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT", "SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT_TARGETS",
                "SORT4_STRICT_LFT_CUT", "SORT4_CALLBACK_UNWIND"):
        environment.pop(key, None)
    stages: dict[str, dict] = {}

    def execute(name: str, argv: list[str], cap: int,
                stdin_name: str | None = None,
                stdout_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
        remaining = args.deadline_epoch - int(time.time())
        seconds = min(cap, remaining - 10) if remaining > 10 else None
        if seconds is None:
            return {"exit": None, "skipped": "artifact and cleanup reserve"}
        return probe.run_stage(name, argv, fixture, environment, hashes,
                               seconds, stdin_name, stdout_name)

    exporter = str(tool_home / "bin/vf-rust-mir-exporter")
    graphs = {}
    for mode in ("normal", "readonly"):
        switches = (["--vf-rust-mir-exporter:preprocess-readonly"]
                    if mode == "readonly" else [])
        stages[f"{mode}-export"] = execute(
            f"{mode}-export",
            [exporter, "verified/lib.rs", f"--sysroot={args.compiler_sysroot}",
             "--edition", "2021", *switches], 100,
            stdout_name=f"{mode}-mir.bin")
        if stages[f"{mode}-export"]["exit"] == 0:
            stages[f"{mode}-decode"] = execute(
                f"{mode}-decode", ["capnp", "decode", str(schema), "VfMir"],
                60, f"{mode}-mir.bin", f"{mode}-mir.txt")
        else:
            stages[f"{mode}-decode"] = {
                "exit": None, "skipped": f"{mode} export failed"}
        if stages[f"{mode}-decode"]["exit"] == 0:
            graphs[mode] = sort4_capture.graph_inventory(
                fixture / f"{mode}-mir.txt", fixture, mode)
    stages["refinement"] = execute(
        "refinement",
        [str(tool_home / "bin/refinement-checker"), "--rustc-args",
         "--edition 2021", "original/lib.rs", "verified/lib.rs"], 120)
    support = all(stages[name].get("exit") == 0 for name in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export",
        "readonly-decode", "refinement"))
    source_exact = all(row.get("source_exact") is True
                       for row in stages.values() if "source_exact" in row)
    result = {
        **profile,
        "classification": ("CALIBRATION_PAIRED_MIR_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
                           if support and source_exact else
                           "CALIBRATION_SETUP_INCONCLUSIVE"),
        "actual_sort4_proved": False,
        "semantic_frontend_enabled": False,
        "full_verification_invoked": False,
        "source_integrity": source_exact,
        "support_exports_decode_refinement_all_zero": support,
        "graphs": graphs,
        "stages": stages,
    }
    (fixture / "calibration.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return result


def main() -> None:
    hosted_only()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--capture", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true",
                      help="source certificate and exact ghost-strip preflight only")
    parser.add_argument("--source-checkout", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sysroot")
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    record = prepare(args.repo_root.resolve(), args.output.resolve())
    if args.capture:
        need(all((args.source_checkout, args.tool_home, args.schema,
                  args.compiler_sysroot, args.deadline_epoch)),
             "--capture requires pinned tool, schema, compiler and deadline")
        calibration = capture_calibration(args, record)
        classification = calibration["classification"]
    else:
        classification = record["classification"]
    print(json.dumps({"classification": classification,
                      "verified_sha256": record["verified_sha256"]},
                     sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate and run the one-call callback diagnostic on GitHub-hosted Linux."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time


PROFILE_SOURCE = "f76012fb518703b1d98e243ac4f487f16877cfcb"
SMALLSORT_SHA256 = "85c75bc93745ff1d4a6d33939d48408c2f7304aa8ffd952b73199ec1f8a175e1"
STOCK_FNMUT_SHA256 = "599abd73bc551804b41f2d82aeb9c4a42d4c1c2b40396cbabfb2099c0abe1564"
SOURCE_CALL = b"is_less(&*v_base.add(1), &*v_base);"
CASES = ("callback_positive", "callback_false_post")
UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES = (
    "unwind_missing_marker",
    "unwind_duplicate_marker",
    "unwind_moved_marker",
    "unwind_foreign_marker",
    "unwind_false_post",
    "unwind_duplicate_f_owner",
    "unwind_duplicate_left_owner",
)
GHOST_BLOCK = re.compile(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/", re.S)
GHOST_LINE = re.compile(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*//@[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)")
UNWIND_MARKER = re.compile(
    rb"        /\*@ \{\n"
    rb"            __vf_callback_unwind_pair\(\);\n"
    rb"            \{ close comparison_debt::<T>\([^\n]+\); \}\n"
    rb"            \{ recover_pair::<T>\(left, right\); \}\n"
    rb"        \} @\*/\n")


def need(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def hosted_only() -> None:
    need(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
         os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted" and
         os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS") == "Linux",
         "callback probe is hosted-only (GitHub-hosted Linux required)")


def strip_ghost(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    data = GHOST_BLOCK.sub(b"", data)
    return GHOST_LINE.sub(b"", data)


def source_certificate(repo_root: Path, source_checkout: Path,
                       tool_home: Path) -> dict:
    source = repo_root / "library/core/src/slice/sort/shared/smallsort.rs"
    source_bytes = source.read_bytes()
    need(sha(source_bytes) == SMALLSORT_SHA256,
         "pinned SmallSort 26.10 source hash differs")
    need(source_bytes.count(SOURCE_CALL) == 1,
         "actual first comparator call is missing or ambiguous")

    vf_head = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(source_checkout), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    need(vf_head == PROFILE_SOURCE,
         f"VeriFast source base differs: {vf_head}")
    effective_specs = tool_home / "bin/rust/std/lib.rsspec"
    effective_bytes = effective_specs.read_bytes()
    start_anchor = b"    trait FnMut<Args> {"
    end_anchor = b"    trait Fn<Args> {"

    def fnmut_clause(data: bytes) -> bytes:
        start = data.find(start_anchor)
        end = data.find(end_anchor, start + len(start_anchor))
        need(start >= 0 and end > start,
             "cannot locate the stock FnMut contract")
        return data[start:end]

    clause = fnmut_clause(effective_bytes)
    need(sha(clause) == STOCK_FNMUT_SHA256,
         "active profile changed the pinned stock FnMut contract")
    need(b"<Args>.own(t, args)" in clause and
         b"<Self>.own(t, self0)" in clause and
         b"<Self>.own(t, self1)" in clause and
         b"on_unwind_ens thread_token(t)" in clause,
         "stock FnMut resource contract shape differs")
    return {
        "classification": "SOURCE_BOUND_CALLBACK_DIAGNOSTIC",
        "proof_sha": subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(),
        "verifast_source_base": vf_head,
        "small_sort_source": str(source.relative_to(repo_root)),
        "small_sort_sha256": sha(source_bytes),
        "actual_first_call": SOURCE_CALL.decode(),
        "stock_fnmut_clause_sha256": STOCK_FNMUT_SHA256,
        "active_fnmut_clause_matches_stock": True,
        "tool_home_fnmut_spec_sha256": sha(effective_bytes),
        "predeclared_functions": ["callback_positive", "callback_false_post"],
        "trusted_boundary": "stock 26.10 FnMut contract and compiler/source correspondence",
        "actual_sort4_proved": False,
    }


def select_case(template: bytes, name: str) -> bytes:
    begin = f"// CASE_BEGIN {name}\n".encode()
    end = f"// CASE_END {name}\n".encode()
    all_begins = [f"// CASE_BEGIN {case}\n".encode() for case in CASES]
    all_ends = [f"// CASE_END {case}\n".encode() for case in CASES]
    need(all(template.count(marker) == 1
             for marker in (*all_begins, *all_ends)),
         "fixture case markers are missing or duplicated")
    start = template.index(begin) + len(begin)
    stop = template.index(end, start)
    first_case = min(template.index(marker) for marker in all_begins)
    need(stop > start and start >= first_case,
         f"fixture case {name} is empty or out of order")
    # Keep the common ghost declarations, but never include an earlier case
    # when selecting a later one. That keeps each generated proof isolated.
    return template[:first_case] + template[start:stop]


def false_normal_post_span(source: bytes) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
    """Return (normal-ens start, end, false-line), all one-based."""
    lines = source.decode().splitlines()
    spans = []
    for start, line in enumerate(lines):
        if re.match(r"^\s*ens\b", line) is None:
            continue
        content = []
        end = None
        for index in range(start, len(lines)):
            content.append(lines[index])
            if ";" in lines[index]:
                end = index
                break
            if "@*/" in lines[index]:
                break
        if end is None:
            continue
        match = re.search(r"\bfalse\s*;", "\n".join(content))
        if match is None:
            continue
        false_line = start + 1 + "\n".join(content).count("\n", 0, match.start())
        spans.append((start + 1, end + 1, false_line))
    return spans[0] if len(spans) == 1 else None


def unwind_post_span(source: bytes) -> tuple[int, int]:
    lines = source.decode().splitlines()
    starts = [index for index, line in enumerate(lines)
              if re.match(r"^\s*on_unwind_ens\b", line)]
    need(len(starts) == 1, "unwind post is missing or ambiguous")
    start = starts[0]
    ends = [index for index in range(start, len(lines))
            if ";" in lines[index]]
    need(ends and all("@*/" not in line for line in lines[start:ends[0]]),
         "unwind post has no matching semicolon")
    return start + 1, ends[0] + 1


def matrix_source(template: bytes, variant: str) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    """Mutate only a copy of the positive fixture; never relax its runtime call."""
    source = select_case(template, "callback_positive")
    target_fn = "callback_positive"
    markers = list(UNWIND_MARKER.finditer(source))
    need(len(markers) == 1, "positive callback marker shape changed")
    marker = markers[0].group()
    if variant == "unwind_missing_marker":
        source = source.replace(marker, b"", 1)
    elif variant == "unwind_duplicate_marker":
        source = source.replace(marker, marker + marker, 1)
    elif variant == "unwind_moved_marker":
        source = source.replace(marker, marker + b"\n", 1)
    elif variant == "unwind_foreign_marker":
        source = source.replace(b"fn callback_positive<",
                                b"fn callback_foreign<", 1)
        target_fn = "callback_foreign"
    else:
        start, end = unwind_post_span(source)
        lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
        post = b"".join(lines[start - 1:end])
        need(post.count(b"<F>.own(t, less_after)") == 1 and
             post.count(b"<T>.own(t, left_after)") == 1,
             "unwind post resource anchors changed")
        if variant == "unwind_false_post":
            amended = post.replace(b"<F>.own(t, less_after);",
                                   b"<F>.own(t, less_after) &*& false;", 1)
        elif variant == "unwind_duplicate_f_owner":
            amended = post.replace(
                b"<F>.own(t, less_after);",
                b"<F>.own(t, less_after) &*& <F>.own(t, less_after);", 1)
        elif variant == "unwind_duplicate_left_owner":
            amended = post.replace(
                b"<T>.own(t, left_after) &*&",
                b"<T>.own(t, left_after) &*& <T>.own(t, left_after) &*&", 1)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown unwind matrix variant: {variant}")
        need(amended != post, f"matrix post mutation was inert: {variant}")
        lines[start - 1:end] = [amended]
        source = b"".join(lines)
    need(source != select_case(template, "callback_positive"),
         f"matrix mutation was inert: {variant}")
    return source, target_fn


def mir_balanced_pairs(text: str) -> dict[int, int]:
    """Return matching () and [] delimiters, ignoring quoted strings."""
    pairs: dict[int, int] = {}
    stack: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
    quoted = False
    escaped = False
    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if quoted:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif char == '"':
                quoted = False
            continue
        if char == '"':
            quoted = True
        elif char in "([":
            stack.append((char, index))
        elif char in ")]":
            if not stack:
                continue
            opening, start = stack[-1]
            if (opening, char) in (("(", ")"), ("[", "]")):
                stack.pop()
                pairs[start] = index
    return pairs


def mir_enclosing_record(text: str, marker: str,
                         pairs: dict[int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    marker_at = text.find(marker)
    need(marker_at >= 0 and text.find(marker, marker_at + 1) < 0,
         f"MIR marker missing or ambiguous: {marker}")
    candidates = [(start, end) for start, end in pairs.items()
                  if text[start] == "(" and start < marker_at < end]
    need(candidates, f"no balanced record contains MIR marker: {marker}")
    return min(candidates, key=lambda pair: pair[1] - pair[0])


def mir_list_records(text: str, marker: str,
                     pairs: dict[int, int]) -> list[str]:
    marker_at = text.find(marker)
    need(marker_at >= 0 and text.find(marker, marker_at + 1) < 0,
         f"MIR list missing or ambiguous: {marker}")
    start = text.find("[", marker_at + len(marker))
    need(start >= 0 and start in pairs,
         f"MIR list is not balanced: {marker}")
    end = pairs[start]
    result = []
    cursor = start + 1
    while cursor < end:
        while cursor < end and text[cursor] in " \t\r\n,":
            cursor += 1
        if cursor == end:
            break
        need(text[cursor] == "(" and cursor in pairs,
             f"unexpected MIR list entry for {marker}")
        item_end = pairs[cursor]
        result.append(text[cursor:item_end + 1])
        cursor = item_end + 1
    return result


def mir_local(record: str, context: str) -> str:
    matches = re.findall(r'local = \(name = "(_\d+)"\)', record)
    need(len(matches) == 1, f"expected one MIR local in {context}")
    return matches[0]


def mir_lhs(statement: str) -> str | None:
    match = re.search(r'lhsPlace = \(\s*local = \(name = "(_\d+)"\)',
                      statement)
    return match.group(1) if match else None


def callback_mir_alias_audit(decoded: bytes, mode: str, source: bytes,
                             case_name: str) -> dict:
    """Trace both actual call tuple fields back to the named source inputs."""
    text = decoded.decode(errors="replace")
    pairs = mir_balanced_pairs(text)
    body_start, body_end = mir_enclosing_record(
        text, f'defPath = "{case_name}"', pairs)
    body = text[body_start:body_end + 1]
    source_text = source.decode()
    source_lines = source_text.splitlines()
    left_lines = [index for index, line in enumerate(source_lines, 1)
                  if line.strip() == "left: *const T,"]
    right_lines = [index for index, line in enumerate(source_lines, 1)
                   if line.strip() == "right: *const T,"]
    need(len(left_lines) == len(right_lines) == 1,
         "source input declarations are missing or ambiguous")

    body_pairs = mir_balanced_pairs(body)
    body_local_decls = mir_list_records(body, "localDecls =", body_pairs)
    input_ids = {}
    for local_id, expected_line in (("_1", left_lines[0]),
                                    ("_2", right_lines[0])):
        rows = [row for row in body_local_decls
                if f'id = (name = "{local_id}")' in row]
        need(len(rows) == 1, f"source-bound input local is missing: {local_id}")
        line_match = re.search(
            r"sourceInfo = \(\s*span = \(\s*regular = \(\s*lo = \(.*?line = (\d+)",
            rows[0], re.S)
        need(line_match is not None and int(line_match.group(1)) == expected_line,
             f"MIR input {local_id} no longer maps to its source parameter")
        input_ids[local_id] = expected_line

    blocks = mir_list_records(body, "basicBlocks =", body_pairs)
    call_blocks = [block for block in blocks
                   if block.count('name = "core::ops::FnMut::call_mut"') == 1]
    need(len(call_blocks) == 1, "actual FnMut::call_mut block missing or ambiguous")
    block = call_blocks[0]
    block_pairs = mir_balanced_pairs(block)
    statements = mir_list_records(block, "statements =", block_pairs)
    terminator_start = block.find("terminator = (")
    need(terminator_start >= 0, "FnMut call block has no terminator")
    terminator = block[terminator_start:]
    call_args = mir_list_records(terminator, "args =", mir_balanced_pairs(terminator))
    need(len(call_args) == 2, "FnMut call does not have exactly receiver and Args")
    args_local = mir_local(call_args[1], "FnMut::call_mut Args operand")

    tuple_assignments = [statement for statement in statements
                         if mir_lhs(statement) == args_local and
                         "aggregateKind = (tuple = void)" in statement]
    need(len(tuple_assignments) == 1,
         "FnMut Args local has no unique two-field tuple assignment")
    tuple_record = tuple_assignments[0]
    tuple_operands = mir_list_records(
        tuple_record, "operands =", mir_balanced_pairs(tuple_record))
    need(len(tuple_operands) == 2, "FnMut Args tuple is not arity two")
    field_refs = [mir_local(operand, "FnMut Args tuple field")
                  for operand in tuple_operands]
    need(field_refs[0] != field_refs[1], "FnMut Args tuple duplicates a field local")

    chains = []
    for field_ref in field_refs:
        ref_assignments = [statement for statement in statements
                           if mir_lhs(statement) == field_ref and
                           "rhsRvalue = (" in statement and "ref = (" in statement]
        need(len(ref_assignments) == 1,
             f"tuple reference field has no unique borrow assignment: {field_ref}")
        ref_record = ref_assignments[0]
        ref_pairs = mir_balanced_pairs(ref_record)
        ref_place_start = ref_record.find("place = (")
        need(ref_place_start >= 0, "tuple reference assignment has no place")
        ref_open = ref_record.find("(", ref_place_start)
        ref_close = ref_pairs.get(ref_open)
        need(ref_close is not None, "tuple reference place is malformed")
        ref_place = ref_record[ref_open:ref_close + 1]
        borrow_local = mir_local(ref_place, "call-reference borrow place")
        ref_projection = re.search(r"projection = \[(.*?)\]", ref_place, re.S)
        need(ref_projection is not None and "deref = void" in ref_projection.group(1),
             "tuple field reference is not formed from its borrow local")

        borrow_assignments = [statement for statement in statements
                              if mir_lhs(statement) == borrow_local and
                              "rhsRvalue = (" in statement and "ref = (" in statement]
        need(len(borrow_assignments) == 1,
             f"call-reference borrow has no unique source assignment: {borrow_local}")
        borrow_record = borrow_assignments[0]
        borrow_pairs = mir_balanced_pairs(borrow_record)
        borrow_place_start = borrow_record.find("place = (")
        need(borrow_place_start >= 0, "source borrow assignment has no place")
        borrow_open = borrow_record.find("(", borrow_place_start)
        borrow_close = borrow_pairs.get(borrow_open)
        need(borrow_close is not None, "source borrow place is malformed")
        source_place = borrow_record[borrow_open:borrow_close + 1]
        source_local = mir_local(source_place, "source borrow place")
        projection = re.search(r"projection = \[(.*?)\]", source_place, re.S)
        need(projection is not None and "deref = void" in projection.group(1),
             "actual comparator reference is not a dereference of an input pointer")
        chains.append({"tuple_field_local": field_ref,
                       "borrow_local": borrow_local,
                       "source_input_local": source_local})

    need([chain["source_input_local"] for chain in chains] == ["_1", "_2"],
         "actual Args tuple fields do not preserve left/right source-input order")
    return {
        "classification": "ACTUAL_CALLBACK_MIR_ARGUMENT_ALIAS_CHECK",
        "mir_mode": mode,
        "passed": True,
        "source_input_lines": input_ids,
        "args_local": args_local,
        "field_chains": chains,
        "checked_both_actual_borrow_chains_and_fnmut_args_tuple": True,
        "trusted_boundary": (
            "pinned Rust MIR/source correspondence and ghost precreate_ref mapping; "
            "the structural check traces both input parameters through the actual "
            "FnMut::Args aggregate without assuming temporary-local numbers"
        ),
    }


def generate_case(repo_root: Path, source_checkout: Path, tool_home: Path,
                  case_name: str, destination: Path) -> dict:
    need(case_name in (*CASES, *UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES),
         f"unknown fixture case: {case_name}")
    template_path = Path(__file__).with_name("callback-cases.rs")
    template = template_path.read_bytes()
    selected, target_fn = (matrix_source(template, case_name)
                           if case_name in UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES
                           else (select_case(template, case_name), case_name))
    original = strip_ghost(selected)
    positive_runtime = strip_ghost(select_case(template, "callback_positive"))
    false_runtime = strip_ghost(select_case(template, "callback_false_post"))
    positive_runtime = positive_runtime.replace(
        b"pub unsafe fn callback_positive", b"pub unsafe fn CALLBACK")
    false_runtime = false_runtime.replace(
        b"pub unsafe fn callback_false_post", b"pub unsafe fn CALLBACK")
    need(positive_runtime == false_runtime,
         "positive and false-post fixtures differ in ghost-stripped Rust")
    need(b"left: *const T,\n    right: *const T,\n    is_less: &mut F," in original and
         b"F: FnMut(&T, &T) -> bool" in original,
         "callback input order or unrestricted generic FnMut bound changed")
    need(strip_ghost(selected) == original,
         "verified fixture does not strip to its original source")
    need(selected.count(b"pub unsafe fn " + target_fn.encode()) == 1 and
         selected.count(b"is_less/*@::<F, (&'cmp T, &'cmp T), 'cmp>@*/(&*left, &*right)") == 1,
         "selected fixture is not a single exact generic callback call")
    need(original.count(b"is_less(&*left, &*right)") == 1,
         "ghost-free fixture call expression differs")

    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (destination / "original").mkdir()
    (destination / "verified").mkdir()
    (destination / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (destination / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(selected)
    record = source_certificate(repo_root, source_checkout, tool_home)
    target_contract_span = false_normal_post_span(selected)
    if case_name == "callback_false_post":
        need(target_contract_span is not None,
             "false-post target normal ens span missing or ambiguous")
    else:
        need(target_contract_span is None,
             "positive case unexpectedly contains false in a normal post")
    record.update({
        "case": case_name,
        "target_function": target_fn,
        "unwind_matrix_variant": case_name if case_name in UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES else None,
        "unwind_marker_count": selected.count(b"__vf_callback_unwind_pair();"),
        "template_sha256": sha(template),
        "verified_sha256": sha(selected),
        "original_sha256": sha(original),
        "ghost_strip_exact": strip_ghost(selected) == original,
        "positive_false_ghost_stripped_runtime_identical": True,
        "target_function_count": 1,
        "actual_callback_call_count": 1,
        "expected_false_post_span": list(target_contract_span[:2])
            if target_contract_span else None,
        "expected_false_post_line": target_contract_span[2]
            if target_contract_span else None,
        "expected_unwind_post_span": list(unwind_post_span(selected)),
        "domain": "generic sized T and F: FnMut(&T, &T) -> bool; two separated initialized slots",
        "normal_post": "current full T resources for both slots and current F resource; unconstrained bool",
        "unwind_post": "current full T resources for both slots and current F resource; no result or rollback",
        "proof_premises": [],
        "effective_patches": "provided common O2/O3 tool profile; FnMut contract must remain stock",
    })
    if case_name in UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES:
        record["predeclared_functions"] = [target_fn]
    (destination / "fixture.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def run_stage(name: str, argv: list[str], root: Path, env: dict[str, str],
              source_hashes: dict[str, str], timeout_seconds: int,
              stdin_name: str | None = None,
              stdout_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
    paths = {rel: root / rel for rel in source_hashes}
    before = {rel: sha(path.read_bytes()) for rel, path in paths.items()}
    need(before == source_hashes,
         f"source differs before stage {name}")
    stdout_path = root / (stdout_name or f"{name}.log")
    stderr_path = root / f"{name}-stderr.log" if stdout_name else stdout_path
    with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout:
        stderr = stderr_path.open("wb") if stderr_path != stdout_path else subprocess.STDOUT
        try:
            stdin = (root / stdin_name).open("rb") if stdin_name else open(os.devnull, "rb")
            try:
                status = subprocess.run(
                    ["/usr/bin/time", "-v", "-o", str(root / f"{name}-resources.txt"),
                     "timeout", "--signal=TERM", "--kill-after=10s",
                     f"{timeout_seconds}s", *argv],
                    cwd=root, env=env, stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                    check=False).returncode
            finally:
                stdin.close()
        except OSError as exc:
            status = 127
            (stderr if stderr_path != stdout_path else stdout).write(
                f"stage launch error: {exc}\n".encode())
        finally:
            if stderr_path != stdout_path:
                stderr.close()
    after = {rel: sha(path.read_bytes()) for rel, path in paths.items()}
    record = {
        "argv": argv, "exit": status, "timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds,
        "source_before": before, "source_after": after,
        "source_exact": before == after == source_hashes,
        "stdout": stdout_path.name, "stderr": stderr_path.name,
    }
    (root / f"{name}-stage.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def run_case(repo_root: Path, source_checkout: Path, tool_home: Path,
             schema: Path, compiler_sysroot: str, evidence: Path,
             case_name: str, deadline_epoch: int,
             capture_ast_diagnostic: bool, enable_hrtb: bool) -> dict:
    case_dir = evidence / case_name
    fixture = generate_case(repo_root, source_checkout, tool_home,
                            case_name, case_dir)
    hash_tool = lambda path: sha(path.read_bytes())
    compiler = subprocess.run(
        ["rustc", "--version", "--verbose"], check=True,
        capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    fixture["hosted_profile"] = {
        "compiler_version_verbose": compiler,
        "tool_hashes": {
            name: hash_tool(tool_home / "bin" / name)
            for name in ("verifast", "vf-rust-mir-exporter", "refinement-checker")
        },
        "schema_sha256": hash_tool(schema),
        "effective_fnmut_contract_sha256": sha(
            (tool_home / "bin/rust/std/lib.rsspec").read_bytes()),
        "hrtb_output_opt_in": enable_hrtb,
        "hrtb_output_target": fixture["target_function"] if enable_hrtb else None,
    }
    (case_dir / "fixture.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(fixture, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    source_hashes = {
        "original/lib.rs": fixture["original_sha256"],
        "verified/lib.rs": fixture["verified_sha256"],
    }
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.pop("SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT", None)
    env.pop("SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT_TARGETS", None)
    for key in ("SORT4_MAYBEUNINIT_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_SELECT_INTRINSIC_REPO_ROOT",
                "SORT4_POINTER_DROP_REPO_ROOT", "SORT4_MAYBEUNINIT_NEW_REPO_ROOT"):
        env.pop(key, None)
    env["PATH"] = str(tool_home / "bin") + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
    stages: dict[str, dict] = {}

    def stage_budget(cap: int) -> int | None:
        remaining = deadline_epoch - int(time.time())
        return min(cap, remaining - 10) if remaining > 10 else None

    def execute(name: str, argv: list[str], cap: int,
                stdin_name: str | None = None,
                stdout_name: str | None = None,
                hrtb_stage: bool = False) -> dict:
        seconds = stage_budget(cap)
        if seconds is None:
            return {"exit": None, "skipped": "artifact and cleanup reserve"}
        stage_env = env.copy()
        if hrtb_stage and enable_hrtb:
            stage_env["SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT"] = "1"
            stage_env["SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT_TARGETS"] = fixture["target_function"]
        return run_stage(name, argv, case_dir, stage_env, source_hashes, seconds,
                         stdin_name, stdout_name)

    exporter = str(tool_home / "bin/vf-rust-mir-exporter")
    stages["normal-export"] = execute(
        "normal-export", [exporter, "verified/lib.rs",
                          f"--sysroot={compiler_sysroot}", "--edition", "2021"],
        90, stdout_name="normal-mir.bin")
    if stages["normal-export"]["exit"] == 0:
        stages["normal-decode"] = execute(
            "normal-decode", ["capnp", "decode", str(schema), "VfMir"],
            60, "normal-mir.bin", "normal-mir.txt")
    else:
        stages["normal-decode"] = {"exit": None, "skipped": "normal export failed"}

    stages["readonly-export"] = execute(
        "readonly-export", [exporter, "verified/lib.rs",
                            f"--sysroot={compiler_sysroot}", "--edition", "2021",
                            "--vf-rust-mir-exporter:preprocess-readonly"],
        90, stdout_name="readonly-mir.bin")
    if stages["readonly-export"]["exit"] == 0:
        stages["readonly-decode"] = execute(
            "readonly-decode", ["capnp", "decode", str(schema), "VfMir"],
            60, "readonly-mir.bin", "readonly-mir.txt")
    else:
        stages["readonly-decode"] = {"exit": None, "skipped": "readonly export failed"}

    alias_audits = {}
    verified_source = (case_dir / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    target_fn = fixture["target_function"]
    for mode in ("normal", "readonly"):
        mir_path = case_dir / f"{mode}-mir.txt"
        alias_audits[mode] = (callback_mir_alias_audit(
            mir_path.read_bytes(), mode, verified_source, target_fn)
                              if mir_path.is_file() else None)
    alias_audit_ok = all(row is not None and row["passed"]
                         for row in alias_audits.values())

    verifier = str(tool_home / "bin/verifast")
    verifier_argv = [verifier, "-rustc_args", "--edition 2021",
                     "-verbose", "1", "verified/lib.rs"]
    stages["full-verification"] = execute(
        "full-verification", verifier_argv, 180, hrtb_stage=True)
    if capture_ast_diagnostic:
        stages["ast-diagnostic"] = execute(
            "ast-diagnostic", [verifier, "-rustc_args", "--edition 2021",
                               "-verbose", "1", "-dump_ast_with_locs",
                               "verified-ast.txt", "verified/lib.rs"], 90,
            hrtb_stage=True)
    else:
        stages["ast-diagnostic"] = {"exit": None, "skipped": "not requested"}
    stages["refinement"] = execute(
        "refinement", [str(tool_home / "bin/refinement-checker"),
                       "--rustc-args", "--edition 2021",
                       "original/lib.rs", "verified/lib.rs"], 90)

    full_log_path = case_dir / "full-verification.log"
    full_log = full_log_path.read_text(errors="replace") if full_log_path.is_file() else ""
    target_headers = re.findall(
        rf"(?m)^\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?s: verified/lib\.rs\([^)]*\): Verifying function '{re.escape(target_fn)}'",
        full_log)
    errors = [line for line in full_log.splitlines() if ": error:" in line]
    source_integrity = all(
        row.get("source_exact") is True for row in stages.values()
        if "source_exact" in row)
    support_stages = ("normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export",
                      "readonly-decode", "refinement")
    support_ok = all(stages.get(name, {}).get("exit") == 0 for name in support_stages) and \
        alias_audit_ok
    classification = "INCONCLUSIVE"
    intended_negative = False
    if case_name == "callback_false_post" and support_ok and source_integrity and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and len(target_headers) == 1 and \
            len(errors) == 1:
        first_line, last_line = fixture["expected_false_post_span"]
        intended_negative = any(
            "Cannot prove false" in error and
            (location := re.search(r"verified/lib\.rs\((\d+),", error)) is not None and
            first_line <= int(location.group(1)) <= last_line
            for error in errors)
        if intended_negative:
            classification = "INTENDED_FALSE_NORMAL_POST"
    if case_name == "callback_positive" and support_ok and source_integrity and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 0 and len(target_headers) == 1:
        classification = "DIAGNOSTIC_POSITIVE_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
    admission_certificates = {
        "unwind_missing_marker": ("callback_positive", 0,
                                  "exact callback fixture requires one marker; other bodies forbid it"),
        "unwind_duplicate_marker": ("callback_positive", 2,
                                    "exact callback fixture requires one marker; other bodies forbid it"),
        "unwind_moved_marker": ("callback_positive", 1,
                                "marker is not immediately before the actual call span"),
        "unwind_foreign_marker": ("callback_foreign", 1,
                                  "exact callback fixture requires one marker; other bodies forbid it"),
    }
    fatal_lines = [line for line in full_log.splitlines()
                   if line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    certificate = admission_certificates.get(case_name)
    if certificate is not None and support_ok and source_integrity and \
            target_fn == certificate[0] and \
            fixture["unwind_marker_count"] == certificate[1] and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 2 and \
            len(target_headers) == 0 and len(errors) == 0 and \
            fatal_lines == [
                'Fatal error: exception Failure("CALLBACK-UNWIND: '
                f'source/MIR certificate mismatch: {certificate[2]}")'
            ]:
        classification = "INTENDED_UNWIND_MARKER_ADMISSION_REJECTION"
        intended_negative = True
    if case_name == "unwind_false_post" and support_ok and source_integrity and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and len(target_headers) == 1 and \
            len(errors) == 1:
        first_line, last_line = fixture["expected_unwind_post_span"]
        if "Cannot prove false" in errors[0] and \
                (location := re.search(r"verified/lib\.rs\((\d+),", errors[0])) is not None and \
                first_line <= int(location.group(1)) <= last_line:
            classification = "INTENDED_FALSE_UNWIND_POST"
            intended_negative = True
    if case_name in {"unwind_duplicate_f_owner", "unwind_duplicate_left_owner"} and \
            support_ok and source_integrity and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and \
            len(target_headers) == 1 and len(errors) == 1:
        first_line, last_line = fixture["expected_unwind_post_span"]
        location = re.search(r"verified/lib\.rs\((\d+),", errors[0])
        if location is not None and first_line <= int(location.group(1)) <= last_line and \
                "No matching heap chunks" in errors[0]:
            classification = "INTENDED_DUPLICATE_UNWIND_OWNER_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
            intended_negative = True
    result = {
        "classification": classification,
        "accepted_callback_component": False,
        "actual_sort4_proved": False,
        "case": case_name,
        "target_function": target_fn,
        "source_integrity": source_integrity,
        "support_exports_decode_refinement_all_zero": support_ok,
        "target_timed_header_count": len(target_headers),
        "target_timed_headers": target_headers,
        "first_error": errors[0] if errors else None,
        "all_errors": errors,
        "intended_false_post": classification in
            {"INTENDED_FALSE_NORMAL_POST", "INTENDED_FALSE_UNWIND_POST"},
        "intended_negative": intended_negative,
        "actual_argument_alias_audit": alias_audits,
        "actual_argument_alias_audit_passed": alias_audit_ok,
        "normal_mir_sha256": sha((case_dir / "normal-mir.txt").read_bytes())
            if (case_dir / "normal-mir.txt").is_file() else None,
        "readonly_mir_sha256": sha((case_dir / "readonly-mir.txt").read_bytes())
            if (case_dir / "readonly-mir.txt").is_file() else None,
        "stages": stages,
    }
    (case_dir / "outcome.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"case": case_name,
                      "classification": classification,
                      "first_error": result["first_error"],
                      "stages": {name: stage.get("exit")
                                 for name, stage in stages.items()}},
                     sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    hosted_only()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-checkout", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sysroot", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", choices=(*CASES, *UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES, "all"),
                        default="all")
    parser.add_argument("--unwind-matrix", action="store_true",
                        help="run isolated unwind admission and post controls")
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true",
                        help="generate/hash isolated source pairs without invoking tools")
    parser.add_argument("--capture-ast-diagnostic", action="store_true",
                        help="run separate optional -dump_ast_with_locs diagnostic")
    parser.add_argument("--enable-hrtb", action="store_true",
                        help="opt in exact selected body to HRTB output component")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.repo_root = args.repo_root.resolve()
    args.source_checkout = args.source_checkout.resolve()
    args.tool_home = args.tool_home.resolve()
    args.schema = args.schema.resolve()
    args.evidence = args.evidence.resolve()
    need(args.schema.is_file() and args.tool_home.is_dir() and
         args.source_checkout.is_dir(), "pinned tool/source inputs are missing")
    args.evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    need(args.unwind_matrix or args.case not in UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES,
         "unwind matrix case requires --unwind-matrix")
    names = ((*CASES, *UNWIND_MATRIX_CASES) if args.unwind_matrix else CASES) \
        if args.case == "all" else (args.case,)
    outcomes = {}
    if args.prepare_only:
        for case_name in names:
            record = generate_case(
                args.repo_root, args.source_checkout, args.tool_home,
                case_name, args.evidence / case_name)
            outcomes[case_name] = {
                "classification": "PREPARED_NOT_RUN",
                "ghost_strip_exact": record["ghost_strip_exact"],
                "verified_sha256": record["verified_sha256"],
                "original_sha256": record["original_sha256"],
            }
    else:
        for case_name in names:
            if args.deadline_epoch - int(time.time()) <= 15:
                outcomes[case_name] = {"classification": "NOT_RUN",
                                       "reason": "artifact and cleanup reserve"}
                continue
            outcomes[case_name] = run_case(
                args.repo_root, args.source_checkout, args.tool_home,
                args.schema, args.compiler_sysroot, args.evidence,
                case_name, args.deadline_epoch,
                args.capture_ast_diagnostic, args.enable_hrtb)
    aggregate = {
        "profile_source_base": PROFILE_SOURCE,
        "cases": outcomes,
        "all_accepted": False,
        "actual_sort4_proved": False,
    }
    (args.evidence / "summary.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(aggregate, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Hosted-only exact-std-body fixtures for a stronger unsafe forget adapter."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HELPER = HERE.parent / "overnight-helper" / "prepare-forget-frames.py"
VARIANTS = (
    "positive", "false_normal", "owner_duplicate", "owner_wrong_value",
    "thread_duplicate", "owner_loss", "contradictory_pre",
    "weakened_unwind_admission",
)
PROOF_VARIANTS = VARIANTS[:-1]
FUNCTION = "checked_forget_owned"


def load_source_helper():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("forget_own_source_certificate", HELPER)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"source certificate helper unavailable: {HELPER}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


SOURCE = load_source_helper()


def line_of(source: bytes, marker: bytes) -> int:
    lines = [i for i, line in enumerate(source.splitlines(), 1)
             if marker in line]
    SOURCE.require(len(lines) == 1, f"obligation marker ambiguous: {marker!r}")
    return lines[0]


def exact_std_body(repo: Path) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
    certificate = SOURCE.source_certificate(repo)
    std = (repo / "library/core/src/mem/mod.rs").read_bytes()
    body = SOURCE.extract_braced_item(std, SOURCE.FORGET_SIGNATURE)
    SOURCE.require(body == SOURCE.FORGET_BODY,
                   "extracted std forget body differs from pinned body")
    return body, certificate


def fixture(variant: str, body: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    SOURCE.require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown forget-owner variant")
    SOURCE.require(body == SOURCE.FORGET_BODY, "runtime body changed")
    pre = b"thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread &*& <T>.own(tid, t)"
    if variant == "contradictory_pre":
        pre += b" &*& false"
    base_post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& <T>.own(tid, t)"
    post = base_post
    if variant == "false_normal":
        post += b" &*& false"
    elif variant == "owner_duplicate":
        post += b" &*& <T>.own(tid, t)"
    elif variant == "owner_wrong_value":
        post = (b"thread_token(tid) &*& <T>.own(tid, ?other) &*& "
                b"other != t")
    elif variant == "thread_duplicate":
        post += b" &*& thread_token(tid)"
    elif variant == "owner_loss":
        post = b"thread_token(tid)"
    unwind = b"true" if variant == "weakened_unwind_admission" else b"false"
    header = b"use std::mem::ManuallyDrop;\n\n"
    signature = b"pub unsafe fn checked_forget_owned<T>(t: T)\n"
    contract = SOURCE.ghost(b"req " + pre + b";\nens " + post +
                            b";\non_unwind_ens " + unwind + b";")
    original = header + signature + body + b"\n"
    verified = header + signature + contract + body + b"\n"
    SOURCE.require(SOURCE.strip_ghost(verified) == original and
                   original.count(body) == 1 and
                   original.count(b"ManuallyDrop::new(t)") == 1 and
                   original.count(signature) == 1 and
                   original.count(b"unsafe fn ") == 1,
                   "source pair is not one exact-body generic unsafe adapter")
    obligation = None
    if variant in {"false_normal", "owner_duplicate", "owner_wrong_value",
                   "thread_duplicate"}:
        obligation = {"kind": "postcondition", "line": line_of(
            verified, b"ens " + post + b";"), "predicate": {
                "false_normal": "false", "owner_duplicate": "<T>.own",
                "owner_wrong_value": "other != t",
                "thread_duplicate": "thread_token",
            }[variant]}
    elif variant == "owner_loss":
        obligation = {"kind": "leak", "line": line_of(verified, b"}")}
    elif variant == "contradictory_pre":
        obligation = {"kind": "dead_code", "line": line_of(
            verified, signature.strip())}
    elif variant == "weakened_unwind_admission":
        obligation = {"kind": "source_admission", "line": line_of(
            verified, b"on_unwind_ens true;")}
    return original, verified, {
        "variant": variant,
        "target": "generic exact-body owner-preserving unsafe adapter",
        "actual_safe_forget_contract_or_redirect": False,
        "same_runtime_body_as_std_forget": True,
        "unrestricted_sized_T": True,
        "expected_obligation": obligation,
        "original_sha256": SOURCE.digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": SOURCE.digest(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
        "only_one_public_function": True,
    }


def write_case(repo: Path, out: Path, variant: str) -> dict:
    SOURCE.require((os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS"),
                    os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT"),
                    os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS")) ==
                   ("true", "github-hosted", "Linux"),
                   "forget-owner fixtures require GitHub-hosted Linux")
    body, certificate = exact_std_body(repo)
    original, verified, record = fixture(variant, body)
    SOURCE.require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (out / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record["source_certificate"] = certificate
    (out / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--variant", required=True, choices=VARIANTS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(write_case(args.repo, args.out, args.variant),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hosted source-only six-body fixture for the actual qualified guard Drop."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]


def load(path: Path, name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"missing source preparer: {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


OWNER = load(REPO / "research/challenge-8/overnight-helper/"
             "prepare-actual-owner-linked.py", "actual_nested_owner_source")
H2 = load(REPO / "research/challenge-8/overnight-guard/"
          "capture-guard-linkage.py", "actual_nested_generic_method_source")
FORGET = load(REPO / "research/challenge-8/overnight-forget-own/"
              "prepare.py", "actual_owned_forget_source")
ACTUAL_MARKER = b"pub fn select_unpredictable<Element>("
METHOD_MARKER = b"pub unsafe fn sort4_checked_generic_drop<T>(slot: *mut T)"
FORGET_MARKER = b"pub unsafe fn checked_forget_owned<T>(t: T)"
DROP_MARKER = b"impl<T> Drop for DropOnPanic<T> {"


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    OWNER.OWNER.require(ok, why)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def write_case(repo: Path, out: Path, *, with_owned_forget: bool = False) -> dict:
    require((os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS"),
             os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT"),
             os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS")) ==
            ("true", "github-hosted", "Linux"),
            "actual nested capture requires GitHub-hosted Linux")
    require(repo.resolve() == REPO.resolve() and not out.exists(),
            "actual nested repository/evidence identity changed")
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    base = out / "linked-owner-base"
    # O23 showed that the prototype implementation proof's call() returns
    # fn_outcome<*Element>.  This new source-only variant projects its normal
    # value while retaining the original full post and false unwind post.
    base_record = OWNER.write_case(
        repo, base, safety_proof_variant="outcome_result",
        owner_literal=True)
    base_case = base / "linked-owner"
    old_verified = (base_case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    old_original = (base_case / "original/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    method_body, method_cert = H2.H2A.source_certificate()
    method = H2.checked_method(method_body)
    require(old_verified.count(ACTUAL_MARKER) == 1 and
            old_original.count(ACTUAL_MARKER) == 1 and
            old_verified.count(DROP_MARKER) == 1 and
            old_verified.count(METHOD_MARKER) == 0 and
            method.count(METHOD_MARKER) == 1 and
            method.count(method_body) == 1,
            "actual nested source insertion boundary changed")
    at = old_verified.index(ACTUAL_MARKER)
    verified = old_verified[:at] + method + b"\n" + old_verified[at:]
    original = OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(verified)
    actual_body, actual_cert = OWNER.OWNER.ACTUAL.source_certificate(repo)
    require(OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(old_verified) == old_original and
            old_original.count(actual_body) == 1 and
            original.count(actual_body) == 1 and
            verified.count(ACTUAL_MARKER) ==
              verified.count(METHOD_MARKER) ==
              verified.count(DROP_MARKER) == 1 and
            verified.count(OWNER.OWNER.OWNER_PRED) == 1 and
            verified.count(OWNER.OWNER.NESTED_DROP_GHOST) == 1 and
            verified.count(b"safety_proof {") == 1 and
            verified.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1 and
            verified.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") == 3 and
            original.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1 and
            original.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") == 3,
            "actual nested runtime/ghost/contract inventory changed")
    case = out / "six-body"
    (case / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (case / "verified").mkdir()
    (case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {
        "classification": "SOURCE_ONLY_ACTUAL_NESTED_DROP_SIX_BODY",
        "actual_helper_proved": False,
        "actual_nested_drop_proved": False,
        "generic_method_proved_in_this_unit": False,
        "frontend_gate_installed": False,
        "original_sha256": sha(original),
        "verified_sha256": sha(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(verified) == original,
        "source_order": [
            "sort4_certified_maybeuninit::sort4_checked_maybeuninit_new",
            "sort4_checked_as_mut_ptr", "sort4_checked_pointer_drop",
            "sort4_checked_generic_drop", "select_unpredictable",
            "<select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic<T> as std::ops::Drop>::drop",
        ],
        "base_linked_owner_source": base_record,
        "actual_safety_proof_variant": "outcome_result",
        "generic_method_source_certificate": method_cert,
        "actual_source_certificate": actual_cert,
    }
    (case / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    if with_owned_forget:
        owned_body, owned_cert = FORGET.exact_std_body(repo)
        _, owned_verified, owned_record = FORGET.fixture(
            "positive", owned_body)
        import_line = b"use std::mem::MaybeUninit;\n"
        owned_import = b"use std::mem::ManuallyDrop;\n"
        owned_header = owned_import + b"\n"
        require(owned_verified.startswith(owned_header) and
                verified.count(import_line) == 1 and
                verified.count(b"    use std::mem::ManuallyDrop;\n") == 1 and
                verified.count(b"\nuse std::mem::ManuallyDrop;\n") == 0 and
                verified.count(FORGET_MARKER) == 0,
                "owner-preserving callee import/source boundary changed")
        owned_method = owned_verified[len(owned_header):]
        require(owned_method.count(FORGET_MARKER) == 1 and
                owned_method.count(owned_body) == 1,
                "owner-preserving exact callee source changed")
        owned = verified.replace(import_line, import_line + owned_import, 1)
        at = owned.index(ACTUAL_MARKER)
        owned = owned[:at] + owned_method + b"\n" + owned[at:]
        original_open = OWNER.OWNER.OPEN_OWNER
        saved = (
            b"        /*@ assert <select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic<*Element>>.own(t, ?saved_guard); @*/\n"
        )
        returned_open = (
            b"        /*@ open <select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic<*Element>>.own(t, saved_guard); @*/\n"
            b"        /*@ assert *saved_guard.inner |-> ?selected_payload; @*/\n"
            b"        /*@ open raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(t, selected_payload); @*/\n"
        )
        forget_call = b"        crate::mem::forget(guard);\n"
        require(owned.count(original_open) == 1 and
                owned.count(forget_call) == 1 and
                owned.count(saved) == 0 and
                owned.count(returned_open) == 0,
                "owner-preserving ghost transfer anchor changed")
        owned = owned.replace(original_open, saved, 1)
        owned = owned.replace(forget_call, forget_call + returned_open, 1)
        owned_original = OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(owned)
        require(owned_original.count(actual_body) == 1 and
                owned_original.count(owned_body) == 1 and
                owned.count(FORGET_MARKER) == 1 and
                owned.count(OWNER.OWNER.OWNER_PRED) == 1 and
                owned.count(b"safety_proof {") == 1 and
                owned.count(OWNER.OWNER.NESTED_DROP_GHOST) == 1 and
                owned.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1 and
                owned.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") == 3,
                "owner-preserving seven-body executable inventory changed")
        owned_case = out / "seven-body-owned-forget"
        (owned_case / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
        (owned_case / "verified").mkdir()
        (owned_case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(owned_original)
        (owned_case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(owned)
        owned_case_record = {
            "classification": "SOURCE_ONLY_ACTUAL_OWNED_FORGET_SEVEN_BODY",
            "actual_helper_proved": False,
            "actual_nested_drop_proved": False,
            "actual_safe_forget_linked": False,
            "original_sha256": sha(owned_original),
            "verified_sha256": sha(owned),
            "ghost_strip_identity": OWNER.OWNER.strip_ghost(owned) ==
                owned_original,
            "source_order": record["source_order"][:4] +
                ["checked_forget_owned"] + record["source_order"][4:],
            "generic_pointer_drop_source_certificate": method_cert,
            "owner_preserving_forget_source_certificate": owned_cert,
            "owner_preserving_forget_positive_fixture": owned_record,
            "actual_source_certificate": actual_cert,
        }
        (owned_case / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(
            owned_case_record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        record["owned_forget_seven_body"] = owned_case_record
    return record


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--with-owned-forget", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(write_case(args.repo, args.out,
                                with_owned_forget=args.with_owned_forget),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
