"""Hosted H2a capture of the source-exact, generic pointer-drop method copy.

This driver does not activate or accept a new frontend rule. In particular,
its proof cases cannot establish actual DropOnPanic linkage by themselves.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]


def load(path: Path, name: str):
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot import {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


LINK = load(HERE.parent / "overnight-linkage/check-constructor-linkage.py",
            "guard_generic_pointer_linkage_runner")
CONSTRUCTOR = LINK.CONSTRUCTOR
DROP_SOURCE = load(HERE.parent / "overnight-s6/prepare-pointer-drop-diagnostic.py",
                   "guard_generic_pointer_source")
ACTUAL = LINK.ACTUAL
METHOD = b"sort4_checked_generic_drop"
PROBE = b"sort4_generic_drop_probe"
VARIANTS = ("positive", "missing_owner", "false_normal_post",
            "false_unwind_post", "retains_initialized", "retains_owner")


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)


def source_certificate() -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
    _, pointer_cert = DROP_SOURCE.source_certificate(REPO, CONSTRUCTOR)
    body = DROP_SOURCE.METHOD_BODY.replace(
        b"drop_in_place(self)", b"std::ptr::drop_in_place(slot)", 1)
    require(body.count(b"std::ptr::drop_in_place(slot)") == 1 and
            body.count(b"self") == 0 and
            DROP_SOURCE.METHOD_BODY.count(b"drop_in_place(self)") == 1,
            "generic method copy differs from pinned std body")
    actual_body, actual_cert = ACTUAL.source_certificate(REPO)
    require(actual_body.count(b"impl<T> Drop for DropOnPanic<T>") == 1 and
            actual_body.count(b"unsafe { self.inner.drop_in_place() }") == 1,
            "actual nested generic Drop body changed")
    return body, {
        "method_std_source": pointer_cert,
        "generic_copy_body_sha256": LINK.sha(body),
        "generic_binding_changes": ["self -> slot", "free call -> std::ptr::drop_in_place"],
        "actual_nested_drop_body_sha256": LINK.sha(actual_body),
        "actual_source_certificate": actual_cert,
        "source_exact": True,
        "typed_mir_gate": "PENDING_CAPTURE",
        "actual_call_redirect": False,
        "nominal_owner_proved": False,
    }


def contract(pre: bytes, post: bytes, unwind: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(pre.startswith(b"req ") and post.startswith(b"ens ") and
            unwind.startswith(b"on_unwind_ens ") and
            all(x.endswith(b";") for x in (pre, post, unwind)),
            "incomplete generic drop contract")
    return CONSTRUCTOR.ghost_block(b"\n".join((pre, post, unwind)))


def source_pair(body: bytes, variant: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown H2a variant")
    method_common = b"thread_token(t)"
    probe_common = b"thread_token(t) &*& type_interp::<T>()"
    method_contract = contract(
        b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& "
        b"*slot |-> ?value &*& <T>.own(t, value);",
        b"ens " + method_common + b" &*& *slot |-> _;",
        b"on_unwind_ens " + method_common + b" &*& *slot |-> _;")
    method = (b"pub unsafe fn " + METHOD + b"<T>(slot: *mut T)\n" +
              method_contract + body + b"\n\n")
    pre = (b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& type_interp::<T>() &*& *slot |-> ?value" +
           (b"" if variant == "missing_owner" else b" &*& <T>.own(t, value)") +
           b" &*& [?f](*frame |-> ?frame_value);")
    retained = probe_common + b" &*& *slot |-> _ &*& [f](*frame |-> frame_value)"
    normal_post = (
        b"false" if variant == "false_normal_post" else
        probe_common + b" &*& *slot |-> value &*& [f](*frame |-> frame_value)"
        if variant == "retains_initialized" else
        retained + b" &*& <T>.own(t, value)"
        if variant == "retains_owner" else retained)
    post = b"ens " + normal_post + b";"
    unwind = b"on_unwind_ens " + (
        b"false" if variant == "false_unwind_post" else retained) + b";"
    probe = (b"pub unsafe fn " + PROBE + b"<T>(slot: *mut T, frame: *const u8)\n" +
             contract(pre, post, unwind) +
             b"{ unsafe { sort4_checked_generic_drop(slot) } }\n")
    verified = b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n" + method + probe
    original = CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified)
    require(original.count(body) == verified.count(body) == 1 and
            original.count(b"std::ptr::drop_in_place(slot)") == 1 and
            CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original,
            "ghost source pair changed generic method runtime body")
    return original, verified


def run_case(case: Path, args) -> dict:
    exporter = str(args.tool_home / "bin/vf-rust-mir-exporter")
    stages = {}
    stages["normal-export"] = LINK.stage(case, "normal-export", [
        exporter, "verified/lib.rs", f"--sysroot={args.compiler_sysroot}",
        "--edition", "2021"], args, output_name="normal-mir.bin")
    stages["readonly-export"] = LINK.stage(case, "readonly-export", [
        exporter, "verified/lib.rs", f"--sysroot={args.compiler_sysroot}",
        "--edition", "2021", "--crate-type", "lib",
        "--vf-rust-mir-exporter:preprocess-readonly"], args,
        output_name="readonly-mir.bin")
    for mode in ("normal", "readonly"):
        if stages[f"{mode}-export"]["exit"] == 0:
            stages[f"{mode}-decode"] = LINK.stage(case, f"{mode}-decode", [
                "capnp", "decode", str(args.schema), "VfMir"], args,
                input_name=f"{mode}-mir.bin", output_name=f"{mode}-mir.txt",
                cap_seconds=40)
    four = all(stages.get(k, {}).get("exit") == 0 for k in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export", "readonly-decode"))
    if four:
        stages["full-verification"] = LINK.stage(case, "full-verification", [
            str(args.tool_home / "bin/verifast"), "-rustc_args", "--edition 2021",
            "-verbose", "1", "verified/lib.rs"], args, cap_seconds=100)
        stages["refinement"] = LINK.stage(case, "refinement", [
            str(args.tool_home / "bin/refinement-checker"), "--rustc-args",
            "--edition 2021", "original/lib.rs", "verified/lib.rs"], args,
            cap_seconds=70)
    return stages


def classify(case: Path, variant: str, stages: dict) -> dict:
    complete = all(stages.get(k, {}).get("exit") == 0 for k in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export", "readonly-decode",
        "refinement"))
    intact = all(s.get("source_unchanged") is True for s in stages.values())
    log = (case / "full-verification.log").read_text(errors="replace") if \
        (case / "full-verification.log").exists() else ""
    errors = LINK.ERR.findall(log)
    fatal = [line for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    method_name, probe_name = METHOD.decode(), PROBE.decode()
    method_log = LINK.function_log(log, method_name) if hasattr(LINK, "function_log") else ""
    if not method_log:
        start = log.find("Verifying function '" + method_name + "'")
        end = log.find("Verifying function '", start + 1) if start >= 0 else -1
        method_log = log[start:end if end >= 0 else None] if start >= 0 else ""
    probe_start = log.find("Verifying function '" + probe_name + "'")
    probe_end = log.find("Verifying function '", probe_start + 1) if probe_start >= 0 else -1
    probe_log = log[probe_start:probe_end if probe_end >= 0 else None] if probe_start >= 0 else ""
    result = {
        "variant": variant, "classification": "DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
        "component_accepted": False, "actual_drop_proved": False,
        "frontend_refinement": complete, "source_integrity": intact,
        "full_verifier_exit": stages.get("full-verification", {}).get("exit"),
        "first_error": errors[0] if errors else None, "fatal": fatal,
        "generic_method_entered": bool(method_log),
        "generic_method_return_and_leak": "Executing return statement" in method_log and
            "Leak check." in method_log,
        "probe_entered": bool(probe_log),
        "probe_return_and_leak": "Executing return statement" in probe_log and
            "Leak check." in probe_log,
        "stages": stages,
    }
    if variant == "positive" and complete and intact and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 0 and \
            result["generic_method_return_and_leak"] and \
            result["probe_return_and_leak"] and not errors and not fatal:
        result["classification"] = "GENERIC_METHOD_LOCAL_PROOF_DIAGNOSTIC"
    elif variant in ("missing_owner", "false_normal_post",
                    "false_unwind_post") and complete and intact and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and len(errors) == 1 and \
            not fatal and result["generic_method_return_and_leak"] and \
            result["probe_entered"]:
        result["classification"] = "TARGET_PROBE_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC"
    elif variant in ("retains_initialized", "retains_owner") and \
            complete and intact and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and len(errors) == 1 and \
            not fatal and result["generic_method_return_and_leak"] and \
            result["probe_entered"] and \
            errors[0][0] == "verified/lib.rs" and \
            (b"*slot |-> value" if variant == "retains_initialized" else
             b"<T>.own(t, value)") in \
                (case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes().splitlines()[int(errors[0][1]) - 1] and \
            "No matching heap chunks:" in errors[0][3] and \
            ("points_to" if variant == "retains_initialized" else "own") in errors[0][3]:
        result["classification"] = "EXACT_CALLEE_RESOURCE_POST_NEGATIVE"
    elif variant == "retains_initialized" and complete and intact and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and \
            len(errors) == 1 and not fatal and \
            method_log.count("Leak check.") >= 2 and \
            result["probe_entered"] and \
            "Executing return statement" in probe_log and \
            errors[0][0].endswith("/prelude_core.rsspec") and \
            errors[0][1] == "213" and \
            "Cannot prove that 'dummy' is not an instance of constructor 'none'" in errors[0][3]:
        post_lines = [i for i, line in enumerate(
            (case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes().splitlines(), 1)
            if line.startswith(b"ens thread_token(t)") and
            b"*slot |-> value" in line]
        if len(post_lines) == 1 and \
                f"verified/lib.rs({post_lines[0]}," in probe_log and \
                "note: Consuming assertion" in probe_log:
            result["classification"] = \
                "EXACT_CALLEE_OPTIONAL_STORAGE_POST_NEGATIVE"
    LINK.write_json(case / "classification.json", result)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sysroot", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--variants", nargs="+", choices=VARIANTS,
                        default=list(VARIANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS") == "Linux", "GitHub-hosted Linux required")
    evidence = args.evidence.resolve()
    require(not evidence.exists(), f"refusing overwrite: {evidence}")
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
    body, certificate = source_certificate()
    LINK.write_json(evidence / "source-certificate.json", certificate)
    results = []
    for variant in args.variants:
        case = evidence / variant
        case.mkdir()
        (case / "original").mkdir()
        (case / "verified").mkdir()
        original, verified = source_pair(body, variant)
        (case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
        (case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
        LINK.write_json(case / "fixture.json", {
            "variant": variant, "source_certificate": certificate,
            "original_sha256": LINK.sha(original),
            "verified_sha256": LINK.sha(verified),
            "source_exact": CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original,
            "actual_runtime_modified": False,
        })
        results.append(classify(case, variant, run_case(case, args)))
    LINK.write_json(evidence / "summary.json", {
        "classification": "H2A_CAPTURE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
        "component_accepted": False,
        "actual_drop_proved": False,
        "source_certificate": certificate,
        "results": results,
    })


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hosted diagnostic: checked generic method beside source-exact SAFE guard Drop.

This is a local-DefPath source/MIR capture and later H2 frontend gate probe.
It never asserts that the actual nested Drop or outer helper is proved.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def load(name: str, path: Path):
    import importlib.util
    import sys
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"missing H2 capture module: {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


H2A = load("h2_generic_method_link_capture", HERE / "capture-generic-pointer-drop.py")
H2B = load("h2_guard_owner_link_capture", HERE / "capture-guard-owner.py")
LINK = H2A.LINK
REPO = H2A.REPO
VARIANTS = ("positive", "method_operand", "guard_operand",
            "owner_predicate", "field_visibility", "missing_cell",
            "wrong_target", "duplicate_owner_post")
METHOD_SIGNATURE = b"pub unsafe fn sort4_checked_generic_drop<T>(slot: *mut T)"
PROBE_SIGNATURE = b"pub unsafe fn sort4_generic_drop_probe<T>"
GUARD_SIGNATURE = b"struct DropOnPanic<T>"
WITNESS_SIGNATURE = b"pub unsafe fn guard_owner_u32_witness("


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)


def checked_method(body: bytes) -> bytes:
    _, verified = H2A.source_pair(body, "positive")
    require(verified.count(METHOD_SIGNATURE) == 1 and
            verified.count(PROBE_SIGNATURE) == 1,
            "H2a source pair changed method/probe boundaries")
    begin, end = verified.index(METHOD_SIGNATURE), verified.index(PROBE_SIGNATURE)
    require(begin < end, "H2a method order changed")
    method = verified[begin:end]
    require(method.count(body) == 1 and method.count(PROBE_SIGNATURE) == 0,
            "H2a certified body escaped the local method")
    return method


def source_pair(method: bytes, struct_body: bytes, drop_body: bytes,
                variant: str, template_active: bool = False) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown H2 linkage variant")
    require(template_active or variant in VARIANTS[:3],
            "H2b source controls require the separate template overlay")
    owner_variant = (variant if variant in ("missing_cell", "wrong_target")
                     else "owner_positive")
    original, verified = H2B.guard_source(struct_body, drop_body,
                                          owner_variant)
    if not template_active:
        # Keep the original H2a isolation unchanged: the concrete witness is
        # an independent H2b obligation, never a prerequisite for H2a.
        start = verified.index(WITNESS_SIGNATURE)
        end = verified.index(b"impl<T> Drop for DropOnPanic<T>", start)
        require(start < end and verified.count(WITNESS_SIGNATURE) == 1,
                "H2b witness boundary changed")
        verified = verified[:start] + verified[end:]
    require(verified.startswith(b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n") and
            verified.count(GUARD_SIGNATURE) == 1 and
            verified.count(METHOD_SIGNATURE) == 0,
            "guard fixture prefix/identity changed")
    if variant == "method_operand":
        marker = b"std::ptr::drop_in_place(slot)"
        require(method.count(marker) == 1, "method operand mutant not unique")
        method = method.replace(marker,
                                b"std::ptr::drop_in_place(slot.wrapping_add(0))", 1)
    verified = verified.replace(
        b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n",
        b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n" + method + b"\n", 1)
    if template_active:
        _, ordinary = H2B.ordinary_source()
        preamble = b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n"
        require(ordinary.startswith(preamble) and
                ordinary.count(b"impl Drop for OrdinaryDrop") == 1,
                "ordinary Drop same-unit control changed")
        verified += b"\n" + ordinary[len(preamble):]
    if variant == "guard_operand":
        marker = H2B.ACTUAL_DROP_CALL
        require(verified.count(marker) == 1, "guard operand mutant not unique")
        verified = verified.replace(
            marker, b"unsafe { core::ptr::null_mut::<T>().drop_in_place() }", 1)
    if variant == "owner_predicate":
        marker = b"*g.inner |-> ?payload &*& <T>.own(t, payload);"
        require(verified.count(marker) == 1,
                "nominal owner source mutant is not unique")
        verified = verified.replace(
            marker, b"*g.inner |-> ?payload &*& <T>.own(t, payload) &*& true;", 1)
    if variant == "field_visibility":
        marker = b"inner: *mut T"
        require(verified.count(marker) == 1,
                "private guard field source mutant is not unique")
        verified = verified.replace(marker, b"pub inner: *mut T", 1)
    if variant == "duplicate_owner_post":
        marker = (b"ens thread_token(t) &*& type_interp::<T>() &*& "
                  b"<DropOnPanic<T>>.own(t, result);")
        require(verified.count(marker) == 1,
                "owner-duplication post control is not unique")
        verified = verified.replace(
            marker, marker[:-1] + b" &*& *slot |-> ?duplicate;", 1)
    original = H2A.CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified)
    require(H2A.CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original and
            original.count(METHOD_SIGNATURE) == 1 and
            original.count(GUARD_SIGNATURE) == 1 and
            (original.count(WITNESS_SIGNATURE) ==
             (0 if variant in ("missing_cell", "wrong_target") else 1)
             if template_active else
             original.count(WITNESS_SIGNATURE) == 0) and
            (original.count(b"impl Drop for OrdinaryDrop") == 1 if template_active
             else original.count(b"impl Drop for OrdinaryDrop") == 0) and
            (original.count(drop_body) == 1 if variant != "guard_operand" else
             original.count(drop_body) == 0),
            "H2 linkage fixture runtime identity changed")
    return original, verified


def classify(case: Path, variant: str, stages: dict,
             template_active: bool = False) -> dict:
    complete = all(stages.get(k, {}).get("exit") == 0 for k in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export", "readonly-decode",
        "refinement"))
    intact = all(s.get("source_unchanged") is True for s in stages.values())
    log = (case / "full-verification.log").read_text(errors="replace") if \
        (case / "full-verification.log").exists() else ""
    errors = LINK.ERR.findall(log)
    fatal = [line for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    gate_line = "SORT4-GENERIC-GUARD: source/MIR local link accepted"
    method_start = log.find("Verifying function 'sort4_checked_generic_drop'")
    method_end = log.find("Verifying function '", method_start + 1) if method_start >= 0 else -1
    method_log = log[method_start:method_end if method_end >= 0 else None] if \
        method_start >= 0 else ""
    guard_start = log.find("Verifying function '<DropOnPanic<T> as std::ops::Drop>::drop'")
    guard_end = log.find("Verifying function '", guard_start + 1) if guard_start >= 0 else -1
    guard_log = log[guard_start:guard_end if guard_end >= 0 else None] if \
        guard_start >= 0 else ""
    def segment(name: str) -> str:
        begin = log.find("Verifying function '" + name + "'")
        ending = log.find("Verifying function '", begin + 1) if begin >= 0 else -1
        return log[begin:ending if ending >= 0 else None] if begin >= 0 else ""

    ctor_log = segment("guard_owner_from_initialized_slot")
    witness_log = segment("guard_owner_u32_witness")
    ordinary_log = segment("<OrdinaryDrop as std::ops::Drop>::drop")
    def two_outcomes(segment_log: str) -> bool:
        # A single observed return is insufficient: SAFE Drop has normal and
        # unwind continuations, both of which must close and leak-check.
        returns = [line for line in segment_log.splitlines()
                   if "Executing return statement" in line]
        leaks = [line for line in segment_log.splitlines()
                 if "Leak check." in line and ": note:" not in line]
        return len(returns) == len(leaks) == 2 and all(
            segment_log.find(returns[index]) < segment_log.find(leaks[index])
            for index in range(2))
    result = {
        "variant": variant, "classification": "H2_LINKAGE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
        "component_accepted": False, "actual_nested_drop_proved": False,
        "frontend_refinement": complete, "source_integrity": intact,
        "full_verifier_exit": stages.get("full-verification", {}).get("exit"),
        "first_error": errors[0] if errors else None, "fatal": fatal,
        "gate_accepted": gate_line in log,
        "local_generic_method_entered": bool(method_log),
        "local_generic_method_return_and_leak":
            "Executing return statement" in method_log and
            "Leak check." in method_log,
        "local_guard_drop_entered": bool(guard_log),
        "local_guard_drop_return_and_leak":
            "Executing return statement" in guard_log and
            "Leak check." in guard_log,
        "method_normal_and_unwind_return_leak": two_outcomes(method_log),
        "guard_normal_and_unwind_return_leak": two_outcomes(guard_log),
        "constructor_return_leak": "Executing return statement" in ctor_log and
            "Leak check." in ctor_log,
        "concrete_u32_witness_return_leak":
            "Executing return statement" in witness_log and
            "Leak check." in witness_log,
        "ordinary_drop_return_leak":
            "Executing return statement" in ordinary_log and
            "Leak check." in ordinary_log,
        "template_overlay_requested": template_active,
        "owner_constructor_entered": bool(ctor_log),
        "stages": stages,
    }
    expected_gate_reason = {
        "method_operand": "local method exact contract/body",
        "guard_operand": "local guard exact source/ghost owner",
        "owner_predicate": "fixture source marker: /*@",
        "field_visibility": "local guard exact source/ghost owner",
    }.get(variant)
    if complete and intact and expected_gate_reason is not None and \
            result["full_verifier_exit"] == 2 and not errors and \
            len(fatal) == 1 and \
            "SORT4-GENERIC-GUARD: certificate mismatch: " + expected_gate_reason in fatal[0] and \
            not result["gate_accepted"] and \
            not result["local_generic_method_entered"] and \
            not result["local_guard_drop_entered"]:
        result["classification"] = "EXACT_SOURCE_GATE_REJECTION_DIAGNOSTIC"
    elif complete and intact and template_active and \
            variant in ("missing_cell", "wrong_target") and \
            result["full_verifier_exit"] == 1 and len(errors) == 1 and \
            result["gate_accepted"] and not fatal and \
            result["method_normal_and_unwind_return_leak"] and \
            result["owner_constructor_entered"] and \
            not result["local_guard_drop_entered"] and \
            errors[0][0] == "verified/lib.rs" and \
            errors[0][3].startswith("No matching heap chunks: points_to<T>(") and \
            b"*g.inner |-> ?payload" in \
                (case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes().splitlines()[int(errors[0][1]) - 1]:
        result["classification"] = "H2B_OWNER_CONSTRUCTION_NEGATIVE"
    elif complete and intact and template_active and \
            variant == "duplicate_owner_post" and \
            result["full_verifier_exit"] == 1 and len(errors) == 1 and \
            result["gate_accepted"] and not fatal and \
            result["method_normal_and_unwind_return_leak"] and \
            result["owner_constructor_entered"] and \
            not result["local_guard_drop_entered"] and \
            errors[0][0] == "verified/lib.rs" and \
            "No matching heap chunks: points_to" in errors[0][3] and \
            b"*slot |-> ?duplicate" in \
                (case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes().splitlines()[int(errors[0][1]) - 1]:
        result["classification"] = "H2B_NO_DUPLICATE_CELL_NEGATIVE"
    elif complete and intact and variant == "positive" and template_active and \
            result["full_verifier_exit"] == 0 and not errors and not fatal and \
            result["gate_accepted"] and \
            result["method_normal_and_unwind_return_leak"] and \
            result["guard_normal_and_unwind_return_leak"] and \
            result["constructor_return_leak"] and \
            result["concrete_u32_witness_return_leak"] and \
            result["ordinary_drop_return_leak"]:

    elif complete and intact and variant == "positive" and \
            result["gate_accepted"] and \
            result["local_generic_method_return_and_leak"] and \
            result["local_guard_drop_entered"] and not fatal:
        result["classification"] = "LOCAL_METHOD_LINKED_GUARD_PROOF_PENDING"
    LINK.write_json(case / "classification.json", result)
    return result


def main() -> None:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hosted diagnostic for truthful nominal guard ownership and SAFE Drop body.

The local DropOnPanic DefPath is a source-equivalent stand-in, not the actual
function-local DefPath. Nothing here admits an actual-call redirect or a new
generated Drop template.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CAPTURE = None


def load():
    import importlib.util
    import sys
    path = HERE / "capture-generic-pointer-drop.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("guard_generic_drop_capture", path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError("H2a capture runner unavailable")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


CAPTURE = load()
LINK = CAPTURE.LINK
ACTUAL = CAPTURE.ACTUAL
CONSTRUCTOR = CAPTURE.CONSTRUCTOR
REPO = CAPTURE.REPO
VARIANTS = ("owner_positive", "missing_cell", "wrong_target", "ordinary_drop")
STRUCT_SIGNATURE = b"struct DropOnPanic<T>"
DROP_SIGNATURE = b"fn drop(&mut self)"
ACTUAL_DROP_CALL = b"unsafe { self.inner.drop_in_place() }"
OWNER_PRED = (
    b"/*@\npred<T> <DropOnPanic<T>>.own(t, g) =\n"
    b"    *g.inner |-> ?payload &*& <T>.own(t, payload);\n@*/\n"
)
OPEN_OWNER = (
    b"//@ open <DropOnPanic<T>>.full_borrow_content(_t, self)();\n"
    b"            //@ open <DropOnPanic<T>>.own(_t, ?g);\n"
    b"            "
)


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)


def source_certificate() -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    actual_body, actual_cert = ACTUAL.source_certificate(REPO)
    require(actual_body.count(STRUCT_SIGNATURE) == 1 and
            actual_body.count(DROP_SIGNATURE) == 1 and
            actual_body.count(ACTUAL_DROP_CALL) == 1,
            "actual guard source is no longer unique")
    struct_body = CONSTRUCTOR.extract_braced_item(actual_body, STRUCT_SIGNATURE)
    drop_body = CONSTRUCTOR.extract_braced_item(actual_body, DROP_SIGNATURE)
    require(struct_body.count(b"inner: *mut T") == 1 and
            struct_body.count(b"pub inner") == 0 and
            drop_body.count(ACTUAL_DROP_CALL) == 1 and
            drop_body.count(b"// SAFETY: Must be guaranteed on construction of local type `DropOnPanic`.") == 1,
            "actual private field or generic Drop body changed")
    return struct_body, drop_body, {
        "actual_source_certificate": actual_cert,
        "actual_guard_struct_body_sha256": LINK.sha(struct_body),
        "actual_generic_drop_body_sha256": LINK.sha(drop_body),
        "actual_guard_field": "private inner: *mut T",
        "actual_nested_drop_def_path": "<select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic<T> as std::ops::Drop>::drop",
        "local_capture_drop_def_path": "<DropOnPanic<T> as std::ops::Drop>::drop",
        "same_runtime_body": True,
        "same_nominal_def_path": False,
        "actual_call_redirect": False,
        "template_extension_active": False,
    }


def owner_constructor(variant: str) -> bytes:
    require(variant in VARIANTS[:3], "not a guard owner variant")
    params = b"slot: *mut T" + (b", other: *mut T" if variant == "wrong_target" else b"")
    cell = b"*other |-> ?value" if variant == "wrong_target" else b"*slot |-> ?value"
    pre = (b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& type_interp::<T>() &*& " +
           (b"" if variant == "missing_cell" else cell + b" &*& ") +
           (b"<T>.own(t, ?value);" if variant == "missing_cell" else
            b"<T>.own(t, value) &*& slot != other;" if variant == "wrong_target" else
            b"<T>.own(t, value);"))
    post = (b"ens thread_token(t) &*& type_interp::<T>() &*& "
            b"<DropOnPanic<T>>.own(t, result);")
    fn = (b"pub unsafe fn guard_owner_from_initialized_slot<T>(" + params +
          b") -> DropOnPanic<T>\n" +
          CAPTURE.contract(pre, post, b"on_unwind_ens false;") +
          b"{\n    let guard = DropOnPanic { inner: slot };\n"
          b"    //@ close <DropOnPanic<T>>.own(t, guard);\n"
          b"    guard\n}\n")
    return fn


def concrete_u32_witness() -> bytes:
    """Transfer one actual u32 slot cell into the nominal guard owner."""
    return (
        b"pub unsafe fn guard_owner_u32_witness(slot: *mut u32) -> DropOnPanic<u32>\n" +
        CAPTURE.contract(
            b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& type_interp::<u32>() &*& *slot |-> ?value;",
            b"ens thread_token(t) &*& type_interp::<u32>() &*& <DropOnPanic<u32>>.own(t, result);",
            b"on_unwind_ens false;") +
        b"{\n"
        b"    //@ close u32_own(t, value);\n"
        b"    unsafe { guard_owner_from_initialized_slot(slot) }\n"
        b"}\n")


def ordinary_source() -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    verified = (
        b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n"
        b"pub struct OrdinaryDrop { pub value: u32 }\n"
        b"impl Drop for OrdinaryDrop {\n"
        b"    fn drop(&mut self) {\n"
        b"        //@ open <OrdinaryDrop>.full_borrow_content(_t, self)();\n"
        b"        //@ open <OrdinaryDrop>.own(_t, ?ordinary);\n"
        b"    }\n}\n")
    original = CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified)
    require(original.count(b"pub struct OrdinaryDrop") == 1 and
            CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original,
            "ordinary Drop control runtime changed")
    return original, verified


def guard_source(struct_body: bytes, drop_body: bytes,
                 variant: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    require(variant in VARIANTS[:3], "not a guard owner variant")
    require(drop_body.count(ACTUAL_DROP_CALL) == 1,
            "actual unsafe generic Drop call not unique")
    annotated_body = drop_body.replace(ACTUAL_DROP_CALL,
                                       OPEN_OWNER + ACTUAL_DROP_CALL, 1)
    require(CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(annotated_body) == drop_body,
            "ghost opening changed actual generic Drop runtime body")
    actual_struct = STRUCT_SIGNATURE + b" " + struct_body
    actual_impl = (b"impl<T> Drop for DropOnPanic<T> {\n"
                   b"    fn drop(&mut self) " + annotated_body + b"\n}\n")
    verified = (b"#![allow(dead_code)]\n\n" + actual_struct + b"\n\n" +
                OWNER_PRED + b"\n" + owner_constructor(variant) +
                (b"\n" + concrete_u32_witness() if variant == "owner_positive" else b"") +
                b"\n" + actual_impl)
    original = CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified)
    require(original.count(drop_body) == 1 and
            original.count(struct_body) == 1 and
            verified.count(annotated_body) == 1 and
            CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original,
            "local source copy changed pinned actual runtime body")
    return original, verified


def classify(case: Path, variant: str, stages: dict) -> dict:
    complete = all(stages.get(k, {}).get("exit") == 0 for k in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export", "readonly-decode",
        "refinement"))
    intact = all(s.get("source_unchanged") is True for s in stages.values())
    log = (case / "full-verification.log").read_text(errors="replace") if \
        (case / "full-verification.log").exists() else ""
    errors = LINK.ERR.findall(log)
    fatal = [line for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    close_lines = [number for number, line in enumerate(
        (case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes().splitlines(), 1)
        if b"//@ close <DropOnPanic<T>>.own(t, guard);" in line]
    constructor = "guard_owner_from_initialized_slot"
    start = log.find("Verifying function '" + constructor + "'")
    end = log.find("Verifying function '", start + 1) if start >= 0 else -1
    ctor_log = log[start:end if end >= 0 else None] if start >= 0 else ""
    witness_name = "guard_owner_u32_witness"
    witness_start = log.find("Verifying function '" + witness_name + "'")
    witness_end = log.find("Verifying function '", witness_start + 1) if witness_start >= 0 else -1
    witness_log = log[witness_start:witness_end if witness_end >= 0 else None] if witness_start >= 0 else ""
    ordinary_log = log[log.find("Verifying function '<OrdinaryDrop as std::ops::Drop>::drop'"):] \
        if "Verifying function '<OrdinaryDrop as std::ops::Drop>::drop'" in log else ""
    result = {
        "variant": variant, "classification": "DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
        "component_accepted": False, "actual_nested_drop_proved": False,
        "frontend_refinement": complete, "source_integrity": intact,
        "full_verifier_exit": stages.get("full-verification", {}).get("exit"),
        "first_error": errors[0] if errors else None, "fatal": fatal,
        "owner_constructor_entered": bool(ctor_log),
        "owner_constructor_return_and_leak": "Executing return statement" in ctor_log and
            "Leak check." in ctor_log,
        "concrete_u32_witness_return_and_leak": "Executing return statement" in witness_log and
            "Leak check." in witness_log,
        "owner_close_line": close_lines[0] if len(close_lines) == 1 else None,
        "ordinary_drop_entered": bool(ordinary_log),
        "ordinary_drop_return_and_leak": "Executing return statement" in ordinary_log and
            "Leak check." in ordinary_log,
        "stages": stages,
    }
    if variant == "owner_positive" and complete and intact and \
            result["owner_constructor_return_and_leak"] and \
            result["concrete_u32_witness_return_and_leak"] and not fatal:
        result["classification"] = "OWNER_CONSTRUCTED_DIAGNOSTIC"
    elif variant == "ordinary_drop" and complete and intact and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 0 and \
            result["ordinary_drop_return_and_leak"] and not errors and not fatal:
        result["classification"] = "ORDINARY_DROP_STOCK_PROOF_DIAGNOSTIC"
    elif variant in ("missing_cell", "wrong_target") and complete and intact and \
            stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and len(errors) == 1 and \
            len(close_lines) == 1 and \
            errors[0][0] == "verified/lib.rs" and \
            errors[0][3].startswith("No matching heap chunks: points_to<T>(") and \
            b"*g.inner |-> ?payload" in (case / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes().splitlines()[int(errors[0][1]) - 1] and \
            result["owner_constructor_entered"] and \
            "Executing statement" in ctor_log and not fatal:
        result["classification"] = "OWNER_CONSTRUCTION_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC"
    LINK.write_json(case / "classification.json", result)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sysroot", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--variants", nargs="+", choices=VARIANTS,
                        default=list(VARIANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS") == "Linux", "GitHub-hosted Linux required")
    evidence = args.evidence.resolve()
    require(not evidence.exists(), f"refusing overwrite: {evidence}")
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
    struct_body, drop_body, cert = source_certificate()
    LINK.write_json(evidence / "source-certificate.json", cert)
    results = []
    for variant in args.variants:
        case = evidence / variant
        case.mkdir()
        (case / "original").mkdir()
        (case / "verified").mkdir()
        original, verified = ordinary_source() if variant == "ordinary_drop" else \
            guard_source(struct_body, drop_body, variant)
        (case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
        (case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
        LINK.write_json(case / "fixture.json", {
            "variant": variant,
            "source_certificate": cert if variant != "ordinary_drop" else None,
            "actual_drop_runtime_body_exact": variant != "ordinary_drop",
            "local_def_path_only": variant != "ordinary_drop",
            "original_sha256": LINK.sha(original),
            "verified_sha256": LINK.sha(verified),
            "ghost_strip_identity": CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original,
        })
        results.append(classify(case, variant, CAPTURE.run_case(case, args)))
    LINK.write_json(evidence / "summary.json", {
        "classification": "H2B_SAFE_DROP_CAPTURE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY",
        "component_accepted": False,
        "actual_nested_drop_proved": False,
        "source_certificate": cert,
        "results": results,
    })


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Exact-source actual pointer-specialized helper for hosted dependency capture.

No guard/forget redirect or semantic rule is installed. This fixture is not a
helper proof; its purpose is complete typed MIR/first-obligation evidence.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


HINT_SHA = "ce89716d46b8060db2c2da1aef1d4bcccf90e0804fc021d4470c55203501315f"
MAYBE_SHA = "1230d267542337ee2842c29d8227cf8a58fe75c53a2a70efaee3922c4e8e25c0"
SELECT_SIGNATURE = (
    b"pub const fn select_unpredictable<T>(condition: bool, true_val: T, false_val: T) -> T\n"
    b"where\n    T: [const] Destruct,\n{"
)
SELECT_TAIL = b"\n\n/// The expected temporal locality"
REQUIRED = (
    b"struct DropOnPanic<T> {",
    b"impl<T> Drop for DropOnPanic<T> {",
    b"unsafe { self.inner.drop_in_place() }",
    b"let guard = DropOnPanic { inner: guard };",
    b"drop.drop_in_place();",
    b"crate::mem::forget(guard);",
    b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(condition, true_val, false_val).assume_init()",
)


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def load_a1():
    path = Path(__file__).with_name("prepare-assume-init-2610.py")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("overnight_assume_capture", path)
    require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None,
            "A1 complete-MIR helper absent")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def extract_select(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(source.count(SELECT_SIGNATURE) == 1,
            "actual helper signature absent/ambiguous")
    opening = source.index(SELECT_SIGNATURE) + len(SELECT_SIGNATURE) - 1
    # The source is full-file pinned and the next-doc anchor pins the closing
    # boundary, avoiding assumptions about nested comment braces.
    tail = source.find(SELECT_TAIL, opening)
    require(tail > opening and source[tail - 1] == ord("}"),
            "actual helper closing anchor changed")
    body = source[opening:tail]
    require(body.startswith(b"{\n") and body.endswith(b"}"),
            "actual helper body boundary changed")
    return body


def strip_ghost(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return re.sub(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/(?:\r?\n)?", b"", data, flags=re.S)


def source_certificate(repo: Path) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
    hint = (repo / "library/core/src/hint.rs").read_bytes()
    maybe = (repo / "library/core/src/mem/maybe_uninit.rs").read_bytes()
    require(digest(hint) == HINT_SHA and digest(maybe) == MAYBE_SHA,
            "actual helper or MaybeUninit std source pin changed")
    body = extract_select(hint)
    for fragment in REQUIRED:
        require(body.count(fragment) == 1,
                f"actual helper operation absent/ambiguous: {fragment.decode()}")
    require(body.count(b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable(") == 3 and
            body.count(b"MaybeUninit::new(") == 2 and
            body.count(b".as_mut_ptr()") == 2,
            "actual helper call inventory changed")
    return body, {
        "hint_sha256": HINT_SHA,
        "maybe_uninit_sha256": MAYBE_SHA,
        "exact_body_sha256": digest(body),
        "target_signature": SELECT_SIGNATURE.decode(),
        "target_specialization": "T = *const Element; Element unrestricted",
        "runtime_body_exact": True,
        "guard_and_drop_body_retained": True,
        "actual_forget_redirect": False,
        "actual_assume_init_redirect": False,
        "helper_proof_status": "NOT_RUN",
    }


def write_fixture(repo: Path, out: Path) -> dict:
    body, source = source_certificate(repo)
    prefix = (
        b"#![feature(core_intrinsics)]\n#![allow(internal_features)]\n\n"
        b"use std::mem::MaybeUninit;\nuse std::{intrinsics, mem};\n\n"
        b"pub fn select_unpredictable<Element>(\n"
        b"    condition: bool,\n    true_val: *const Element,\n"
        b"    false_val: *const Element,\n) -> *const Element\n"
    )
    contract = (
        b"/*@\nreq thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread;\n@*/\n"
        b"/*@\nens thread_token(t) &*& (result as pointer) ==\n"
        b"    (if condition { true_val as pointer } else { false_val as pointer });\n@*/\n"
        b"/*@\non_unwind_ens false;\n@*/\n"
    )
    verified = prefix + contract + body + b"\n"
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    require(original.count(body) == verified.count(body) == 1 and
            original.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1,
            "actual source pair changed")
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (out / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {"source_certificate": source,
              "original_sha256": digest(original),
              "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
              "ghost_strip_identity": strip_ghost(verified) == original,
              "capture_only": True}
    require(record["ghost_strip_identity"], "ghost stripping changed runtime body")
    (out / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2,
                                                  sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def capture_mir(decoded_path: Path, out: Path) -> dict:
    a1 = load_a1()
    decoded = decoded_path.read_text(errors="strict")
    defpath, body = a1.complete_function_record(decoded, "select_unpredictable")
    require(defpath == "select_unpredictable" or
            defpath.endswith("::select_unpredictable"),
            "captured helper identity differs")
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "helper-full-mir.txt").write_text(body)
    record = {
        "classification": "UNREVIEWED_CAPTURE; NOT A HELPER CERTIFICATE",
        "helper_defpath": defpath,
        "helper_full_mir_sha256": digest(body.encode()),
        "helper_full_mir_bytes": len(body.encode()),

def load(path: Path, name: str):

def strip_ghost(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    source = re.sub(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*/\*@.*?@\*/(?:\r?\n)?", b"", source,
                    flags=re.S)
    source = re.sub(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/(?:\r?\n)?", b"", source, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*//@[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)", b"", source)


def candidate(base_verified: bytes, base_original: bytes,
              owner_post_completion: bool = False,
              owner_safety_proof: bool = False,
              safety_proof_variant: str = "positive",
              owner_literal: bool = False,
              annotate_nested_drop: bool = False) -> bytes:
    verified = base_verified
    require(not (owner_post_completion and owner_safety_proof),
            "completion and stock safety proof are separate experiments")
    require(safety_proof_variant == "positive" or owner_safety_proof,
            "a safety negative requires the stock safety proof lane")
    require(safety_proof_variant in SAFETY_PROOFS,
            "unknown safety proof variant")

        b"\n    (if condition { true_val as pointer } else { false_val as pointer });",
        b"\n        (if condition { true_val as pointer } else { false_val as pointer });",
    )
    matches = [post for post in normal_posts if verified.count(post) == 1]

            sum(verified.count(post) for post in normal_posts) == 1,
            "normal pointer post changed or ambiguous")

        # Historical O16 diagnostic: this stronger implementation post is
        # rejected by the generic std prototype before any body proof.
        after = normal_post[:-1] + b" &*& raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(t, result);"
        verified = verified.replace(normal_post, after, 1)
    if owner_safety_proof:
        anchors = [anchor for anchor in (SAFETY_ANCHOR,
                                       S6_LINKED_SAFETY_ANCHOR)
                   if verified.count(anchor) == 1]
        require(len(anchors) == 1,
                "actual contract/safety proof insertion anchor changed")
        proof = SAFETY_PROOFS[safety_proof_variant]
        require(proof.count(b"call();") == 1 and
                b"assume(" not in proof and b"assume_correct" not in proof and
                proof.count(b"safety_proof {") == 1,
                "safety proof changed its single-call/trust boundary")

            anchors[0],
            anchors[0][:-2] + proof + b"{\n",
            1)
    if annotate_nested_drop:
        require(verified.count(NESTED_DROP_CALL) == 1,
                "actual nested Drop unsafe call anchor changed")

            NESTED_DROP_CALL, NESTED_DROP_GHOST + NESTED_DROP_CALL, 1)

        b"select_unpredictable::DropOnPanic::<*Element> { inner: guard }") == 2,
        "owner logical aggregate must occur in both branches exactly")
    for anchor, ghost in INSERTIONS:
        if owner_literal and anchor == b"        let guard = DropOnPanic { inner: guard };\n":
            ghost = CLOSE_OWNER_LITERAL
        require(verified.count(anchor) == 1,
                f"actual owner insertion anchor ambiguous: {anchor.decode()}")
        verified = verified.replace(anchor, anchor + ghost, 1)
    require(verified.endswith(b"}\n") and verified.count(OWNER_PRED) == 0,
            "actual helper final source boundary changed")

    require(strip_ghost(verified) == base_original,
            "ghost projection changed actual runtime bytes")
    require(verified.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1 and
            verified.count(b"unsafe { self.inner.drop_in_place() }") == 1 and

            "actual call/destructor inventory changed")

VARIANTS = POSITIVES + NEGATIVES
MIR_REQUIRED_NAMES = (
    "assert_inhabited", "transmute_neo", "transmute_unchecked",
)


def require(ok: bool, why: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def extract_braced_item(source: bytes, signature: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(source.count(signature) == 1,
            f"source signature absent/ambiguous: {signature.decode()}")
    opening = source.find(b"{", source.index(signature) + len(signature))
    require(opening >= 0, "source body opening is absent")
    depth = 0
    for at in range(opening, len(source)):
        if source[at] == ord("{"):
            depth += 1
        elif source[at] == ord("}"):
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[opening:at + 1]
    raise ValueError("source body is unterminated")


def certify_source(repo: Path) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
    values = {}
    for relative, expected in SOURCE_SHA.items():
        value = (repo / relative).read_bytes()
        require(digest(value) == expected,
                f"source pin mismatch: {relative}")
        values[relative] = value
    mu = values["library/core/src/mem/maybe_uninit.rs"]
    md = values["library/core/src/mem/manually_drop.rs"]
    mem = values["library/core/src/mem/mod.rs"]
    intrinsics = values["library/core/src/intrinsics/mod.rs"]
    method = extract_braced_item(mu, METHOD_SIGNATURE)
    transmute = extract_braced_item(mem, TRANSMUTE_SIGNATURE)
    union = extract_braced_item(mu, UNION_SIGNATURE)
    manually_drop = extract_braced_item(md, MD_SIGNATURE)
    require(method == METHOD_BODY, "updated assume_init body changed")
    require(transmute == TRANSMUTE_BODY, "transmute_neo body changed")
    require(union == UNION_BODY and manually_drop == MD_BODY,
            "MaybeUninit/ManuallyDrop representation changed")
    require(b"#[rustc_pub_transparent]\n" + UNION_SIGNATURE in mu and
            b"#[repr(transparent)]\n#[rustc_pub_transparent]\n" + MD_SIGNATURE in md,
            "representation attributes changed")
    require(intrinsics.count(ASSERT_INTRINSIC) == 1 and
            intrinsics.count(TRANSMUTE_INTRINSIC) == 1,
            "compiler intrinsic signatures changed")
    for signature in (ASSERT_INTRINSIC, TRANSMUTE_INTRINSIC):
        at = intrinsics.index(signature)
        require(b"#[rustc_nounwind]" in intrinsics[max(0, at - 200):at],
                f"noundwind attribute absent for {signature.decode()}")
    specialized = method.replace(b"::<T>", b"::<*const Element>")
    specialized = specialized.replace(b"transmute_neo(self)",
                                      b"transmute_neo(storage)")
    require(specialized.count(b"assert_inhabited::<*const Element>()") == 1
            and specialized.count(b"transmute_neo(storage)") == 1,
            "typed adapter substitutions changed")
    return specialized, {
        "source_sha256": SOURCE_SHA,
        "method_body_sha256": digest(method),
        "transmute_neo_body_sha256": digest(transmute),
        "union_body_sha256": digest(union),
        "manually_drop_body_sha256": digest(manually_drop),
        "adapter_body_sha256": digest(specialized),
        "compiler_intrinsics": [s.decode() for s in
                                (ASSERT_INTRINSIC, TRANSMUTE_INTRINSIC)],
        "substitutions": ["T -> *const Element", "self -> storage"],
        "representation": "MaybeUninit union value: ManuallyDrop<T>; ManuallyDrop direct value:T",
        "pointer_payload_only": True,
        "element_pointee_rights": False,
        "compiler_correspondence_trusted": True,
        "full_mir_graph_reviewed": False,
        "proof_status": "NOT_RUN",
    }


def ghost(clauses: bytes) -> bytes:
    lines = clauses.splitlines()
    require(len(lines) == 3 and
            lines[0].startswith(b"req ") and
            lines[1].startswith(b"ens ") and
            lines[2].startswith(b"on_unwind_ens ") and
            all(line.endswith(b";") for line in lines),
            "contract must have separate complete req/ens/unwind clauses")
    return b"".join(b"/*@\n" + line + b"\n@*/\n" for line in lines)


def strip_ghost(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    data = re.sub(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/(?:\r?\n)?", b"", data, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*//@[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)", b"", data)


def fixture_source(body: bytes, variant: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown assume_init variant")
    header = (b"#![feature(core_intrinsics, transmute_neo)]\n"
              b"#![allow(internal_features)]\n\n"
              b"use std::intrinsics;\n"
              b"use std::mem::{MaybeUninit, transmute_neo};\n\n")
    adapter_pre = (
        b"thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread &*& "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(storage) == some(?p) &*& "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(tid, storage)"
    )
    adapter_post = (
        b"thread_token(tid) &*& result == p &*& "
        b"raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(tid, result)"
    )
    adapter_contract = ghost(b"req " + adapter_pre + b";\n"
                             b"ens " + adapter_post +
                             b";\non_unwind_ens false;")
    adapter = (b"pub unsafe fn " + ADAPTER_NAME.encode() +
               b"<Element>(storage: MaybeUninit<*const Element>) -> *const Element\n" +
               adapter_contract + body + b"\n")
    pre = b"thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread"
    if variant == "no_thread":
        pre = b"true"
    if variant == "none":
        pre += b" &*& std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(storage) == none"
    elif variant != "unknown":
        pre += b" &*& std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(storage) == some(?p)"
    own_tid = b"currentThread" if variant == "no_thread" else b"tid"
    pre += (b" &*& std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(" +
            own_tid + b", storage)")
    pre += b" &*& *frame |-> ?flag"
    post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& result == p &*& *frame |-> flag"
    if variant in {"none", "unknown"}:
        post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& *frame |-> flag"
    if variant == "no_thread":
        post = b"thread_token(?restored) &*& result == p &*& *frame |-> flag"
    if variant == "false_post":
        post += b" &*& false"
    elif variant == "wrong_result":
        post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& result != p &*& *frame |-> flag"
    elif variant == "frame_loss":
        post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& result == p"
    elif variant == "frame_duplication":
        post += b" &*& *frame |-> flag"
    elif variant == "frame_wrong_value":
        post = (b"thread_token(tid) &*& result == p &*& "
                b"*frame |-> ?changed &*& changed != flag")
    elif variant == "thread_loss":
        post = b"result == p &*& *frame |-> flag"
    elif variant == "thread_duplication":
        post += b" &*& thread_token(tid)"
    elif variant == "element_rights":
        post += b" &*& *result |-> _"
    # The checked method returns value ownership of the raw pointer itself.
    # A successful probe must return that linear resource too; otherwise a
    # positive leaks it, and frame/thread-loss controls fail for two reasons.
    if variant not in {"none", "unknown", "no_thread"}:
        post += b" &*& raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(tid, result)"
    probe_contract = ghost(b"req " + pre + b";\nens " + post +
                           b";\non_unwind_ens false;")
    probe_body = b"{\n    let result = unsafe { " + ADAPTER_NAME.encode() + b"(storage) };\n"
    if variant == "assert_false":
        probe_body += b"    //@ assert false;\n"
    probe_body += b"    result\n}\n"
    probe = (b"pub unsafe fn assume_init_probe<Element>(storage: MaybeUninit<*const Element>, "
             b"frame: *mut bool) -> *const Element\n" + probe_contract + probe_body)
    verified = header + adapter + b"\n" + probe
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    require(original.count(body) == 1 and
            original.count(ADAPTER_NAME.encode() + b"(storage)") == 1,
            "adapter body/call absent or ambiguous")
    return original, verified, {
        "variant": variant,
        "expected": "capture then full proof" if variant in POSITIVES
                    else "capture then intended proof negative",
        "expected_failure": {
            "none": "initialized wrapper requirement at adapter call",
            "unknown": "initialized wrapper requirement at adapter call",
            "false_post": "probe postcondition false",
            "assert_false": "probe assertion false",
            "wrong_result": "probe result equality",
            "frame_loss": "probe frame leak",
            "frame_duplication": "probe duplicate frame postcondition",
            "frame_wrong_value": "probe changed frame value",
            "thread_loss": "probe thread-token leak",
            "thread_duplication": "probe duplicate thread-token postcondition",
            "no_thread": "adapter thread-token precondition",
            "element_rights": "no Element pointee rights at probe postcondition",
        }.get(variant),
        "actual_method_adapter": True,
        "actual_method_called": False,
        "full_mir_graph_reviewed": False,
        "primitive_rule_accepted": False,
        "original_sha256": digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
    }


def transmute_fixture_source(repo: Path) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    # This is an independent exact body copy. The assume_init adapter continues
    # calling the real public transmute_neo; no call is redirected here.
    _, source = certify_source(repo)
    mem = (repo / "library/core/src/mem/mod.rs").read_bytes()
    body = extract_braced_item(mem, TRANSMUTE_SIGNATURE)
    require(body == TRANSMUTE_BODY, "transmute_neo body no longer pinned")
    specialized = body.replace(
        b"Src::SIZE",
        b"<MaybeUninit<*const Element> as SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE"
    ).replace(
        b"Dst::SIZE",
        b"<*const Element as SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE"
    )
    require(specialized.count(b"transmute_unchecked(src)") == 1 and
            specialized.count(b"SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE") == 2,
            "transmute source specialization changed")
    header = (
        b"#![feature(core_intrinsics, sized_type_properties)]\n"
        b"#![allow(internal_features)]\n\n"
        b"use std::intrinsics;\n"
        b"use std::mem::{MaybeUninit, SizedTypeProperties};\n\n"
    )
    signature = (
        b"pub unsafe fn " + TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME.encode() +
        b"<Element>(src: MaybeUninit<*const Element>) -> *const Element\n"
    )
    contract = ghost(
        b"req thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread &*& "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(src) == some(?p) &*& "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(tid, src);\n"
        b"ens thread_token(tid) &*& result == p &*& "
        b"raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(tid, result);\n"
        b"on_unwind_ens false;"
    )
    verified = header + signature + contract + specialized + b"\n"
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    require(original.count(specialized) == 1,
            "local transmute body absent or ambiguous")
    return original, verified, {
        "source_certificate": source,
        "target": "transmute_neo",
        "source_body_sha256": digest(body),
        "specialized_body_sha256": digest(specialized),
        "substitutions": [
            "Src::SIZE -> <MaybeUninit<*const Element> as SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE",
            "Dst::SIZE -> <*const Element as SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE",
        ],
        "compiler_intrinsic_body_proved": False,
        "primitive_rule_accepted": False,
        "original_sha256": digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
    }


def write_fixture(repo: Path, out: Path, variant: str) -> dict:
    body, source = certify_source(repo)
    original, verified, case = fixture_source(body, variant)
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (out / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {"source_certificate": source, **case}
    (out / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2,
                                                  sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def write_transmute_fixture(repo: Path, out: Path) -> dict:
    original, verified, record = transmute_fixture_source(repo)
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (out / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    (out / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2,
                                                  sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def linkage_fixture_source(repo: Path) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    """Place the separately proved callee before the unchanged caller body.

    The caller still resolves `transmute_neo` to the actual std symbol.  This
    fixture captures both complete typed MIR records; it does not redirect a
    call or declare the local callee a summary of that symbol.
    """
    _, callee_verified, callee_record = transmute_fixture_source(repo)
    method_body, source = certify_source(repo)
    _, caller_verified, _ = fixture_source(method_body, "initialized")
    callee_marker = b"pub unsafe fn " + TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME.encode()
    caller_marker = b"pub unsafe fn " + ADAPTER_NAME.encode()
    probe_marker = b"pub unsafe fn assume_init_probe"
    require(callee_verified.count(callee_marker) == 1 and
            caller_verified.count(caller_marker) == 1 and
            caller_verified.count(probe_marker) == 1,
            "linkage function identity absent or ambiguous")
    callee = callee_verified[callee_verified.index(callee_marker):].rstrip()
    caller = caller_verified[caller_verified.index(caller_marker):
                             caller_verified.index(probe_marker)].rstrip()
    header = (
        b"#![feature(core_intrinsics, transmute_neo, sized_type_properties)]\n"
        b"#![allow(internal_features)]\n\n"
        b"use std::intrinsics;\n"
        b"use std::mem::{MaybeUninit, SizedTypeProperties, transmute_neo};\n\n"
    )
    verified = header + callee + b"\n\n" + caller + b"\n"
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    require(original.count(TRANSMUTE_BODY.replace(
                b"Src::SIZE",
                b"<MaybeUninit<*const Element> as SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE"
            ).replace(
                b"Dst::SIZE",
                b"<*const Element as SizedTypeProperties>::SIZE")) == 1 and
            original.count(method_body) == 1 and
            original.count(b"transmute_neo(storage)") == 1 and
            original.count(b"transmute_unchecked(src)") == 1,
            "combined fixture changed an exact source body")
    return original, verified, {
        "classification": "TWO_BODY_LINKAGE_CAPTURE_ONLY; NO REDIRECT OR CALL PROOF",
        "source_certificate": source,
        "callee_source_certificate": callee_record["source_certificate"],
        "caller_target": ADAPTER_NAME,
        "callee_target": TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME,
        "caller_body_sha256": digest(method_body),
        "callee_body_sha256": callee_record["source_body_sha256"],
        "original_sha256": digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
        "actual_std_call_symbol_retained": True,
        "redirect_enabled": False,
        "actual_method_proved": False,
    }

    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")

    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)

LINKAGE_SOURCE_CONTROLS = (
    "weakened_callee_post", "changed_method_call", "extra_callee_statement",
)


def linkage_variant_source(repo: Path, variant: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown method linkage variant")
    _, base, base_record = linkage_fixture_source(repo)
    body, _ = certify_source(repo)
    _, candidate, probe_record = fixture_source(body, variant)
    marker = b"pub unsafe fn assume_init_probe"
    require(candidate.count(marker) == 1, "method probe identity changed")
    probe = candidate[candidate.index(marker):]
    verified = base + b"\n" + probe
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    require(verified[:len(base)] == base and strip_ghost(verified) == original,
            "linkage prefix or ghost stripping changed")
    return original, verified, {
        **base_record,
        "variant": variant,
        "probe_contract": probe_record["expected_failure"],
        "classification": "LINKAGE_METHOD_MATRIX; NO PROOF UNTIL HOSTED",
        "original_sha256": digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
        "redirect_enabled": True,
    }


def write_linkage_variant(repo: Path, out: Path, variant: str) -> dict:
    original, verified, record = linkage_variant_source(repo, variant)
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (out / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    (out / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2,
                                                  sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def linkage_source_control(repo: Path, control: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    require(control in LINKAGE_SOURCE_CONTROLS, "unknown A1 linkage control")
    _, base, record = linkage_fixture_source(repo)
    replacements = {
        "weakened_callee_post":
            (b"ens thread_token(tid) &*& result == p &*& raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(tid, result);",
             b"ens thread_token(tid) &*& true &*& raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(tid, result);"),
        "changed_method_call":
            (b"transmute_neo(storage)",
             b"transmute_neo(MaybeUninit::new(std::ptr::null::<Element>()))"),
        "extra_callee_statement":
            (b"    const { assert!(<MaybeUninit<*const Element>",
             b"    let _ = 0u8;\n    const { assert!(<MaybeUninit<*const Element>"),
    }
    old, new = replacements[control]
    expected_count = 2 if control == "weakened_callee_post" else 1
    require(base.count(old) == expected_count,
            "source-control mutation site ambiguous")
    verified = base.replace(old, new, 1)
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    return original, verified, {
        **record,
        "control": control,
        "classification": "SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_ADMISSION_CONTROL; NOT STD PROOF",
        "original_sha256": digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
        "redirect_enabled": True,
    }


def write_linkage_source_control(repo: Path, out: Path, control: str) -> dict:
    original, verified, record = linkage_source_control(repo, control)
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)

                                                  sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def balanced_record(decoded: str, opening: int) -> str:
    require(decoded[opening] == "(", "MIR record opening missing")
    depth = 0
    in_string = False
    escaped = False
    for at in range(opening, len(decoded)):
        ch = decoded[at]
        if in_string:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif ch == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif ch == '"':
                in_string = False
        elif ch == '"':
            in_string = True
        elif ch == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return decoded[opening:at + 1]
    raise ValueError("MIR record is unterminated")


def complete_function_record(decoded: str, basename: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    # Inspect the *complete* serialized function record; no block is omitted.
    matches = [match for match in re.finditer(r'defPath = "([^"]+)"', decoded)
               if match.group(1) == basename or
               match.group(1).endswith("::" + basename)]
    require(len(matches) == 1,
            f"MIR function identity absent/ambiguous: {basename}")
    match = matches[0]
    lead = decoded.rfind("    ( defKind =", 0, match.start())
    require(lead >= 0, "MIR function record opening missing")
    opening = decoded.index("(", lead)
    body = balanced_record(decoded, opening)
    require(match.group(0) in body and "basicBlocks = [" in body and
            "localDecls = [" in body and "inputs = [" in body,
            "MIR function record is incomplete")
    return match.group(1), body


def capture_mir(decoded_path: Path, out: Path, target: str = "method") -> dict:
    decoded = decoded_path.read_text(errors="strict")
    name = ADAPTER_NAME if target == "method" else TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME
    defpath, body = complete_function_record(decoded, name)
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "adapter-full-mir.txt").write_text(body)
    record = {
        "classification": "UNREVIEWED_CAPTURE; NOT A CERTIFICATE",
        "target": target,
        "adapter_defpath": defpath,
        "adapter_full_mir_sha256": digest(body.encode()),
        "adapter_full_mir_bytes": len(body.encode()),
        "required_name_inventory": {name: decoded.count(name)
                                    for name in MIR_REQUIRED_NAMES},
        "capture_source_sha256": digest(decoded.encode()),
        "full_mir_graph_reviewed": False,
        "primitive_rule_accepted": False,
    }
    (out / "capture.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2,
                                                sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def check_mir(decoded_path: Path, manifest_path: Path, repo: Path) -> dict:
    _, source = certify_source(repo)
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    require(manifest.get("reviewed") is True and
            manifest.get("reviewed_by") and
            manifest.get("source_sha256") == source["source_sha256"] and
            manifest.get("typed_pointer_only") is True and
            manifest.get("target") in {"method", "transmute"},
            "reviewed applicability manifest is incomplete")
    decoded = decoded_path.read_text(errors="strict")
    target = manifest["target"]
    name = ADAPTER_NAME if target == "method" else TRANSMUTE_ADAPTER_NAME
    defpath, body = complete_function_record(decoded, name)
    require(defpath == manifest.get("adapter_defpath") and
            digest(body.encode()) == manifest.get("adapter_full_mir_sha256"),
            "complete adapter typed MIR differs from reviewed manifest")
    if target == "method":
        require(manifest.get("expected_calls") ==
                ["assert_inhabited", "transmute_neo"] and
                all(body.count(callee) == 1 for callee in manifest["expected_calls"]) and
                "transmute_unchecked" not in body,
                "method call inventory differs")
    else:
        require(manifest.get("expected_calls") == [] and
                manifest.get("expected_cast_kind") == "transmute" and
                body.count("kind = (transmute = void)") == 1 and
                "boxDerefTransmute" not in body and
                "assert_inhabited" not in body,
                "transmute body inventory differs")
    return {
        "classification": "FULL_MIR_APPLICABILITY_ONLY",
        "target": target,
        "adapter_defpath": defpath,
        "adapter_full_mir_sha256": digest(body.encode()),
        "source_sha256": SOURCE_SHA,
        "full_graph_byte_identical_to_reviewed": True,
        "primitive_rule_accepted": False,
        "proof_status": "NOT_RUN",
    }


def main() -> None:
    require(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted",
            "fixture/certificate operations are permitted only on GitHub-hosted Actions")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="mode", required=True)
    prepare = sub.add_parser("prepare")
    prepare.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
