#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Generate isolated source-linked generic-forget/frame proof cases.

This is fixture preparation, never a proof classifier. The hosted runner must
check NORMAL/readonly MIR, refinement, full VeriFast and the named negatives.
Do not run this on the editing server; it is intended for GitHub-hosted jobs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path


SOURCE_SHA = {
    "library/core/src/mem/mod.rs":
        "b86a596a58dcb21a45e8b29b33327ca8c7bde708aa6fca158d4366e51403daf2",
    "library/core/src/mem/manually_drop.rs":
        "f9cce798828cc852c00feeea9a6218c225b68d92727a5edbddc7c08a731a4f25",
}
FORGET_SIGNATURE = b"pub const fn forget<T>(t: T)"
FORGET_BODY = b"{\n    let _ = ManuallyDrop::new(t);\n}"
MD_SIGNATURE = b"pub const fn new(value: T) -> ManuallyDrop<T>"
MD_BODY = b"{\n        ManuallyDrop { value }\n    }"
POSITIVES = ("symbolic_frame", "two_frames")
NEGATIVES = (
    "false_post", "assert_false", "frame_loss", "frame_duplication",
    "frame_wrong_value", "cell_loss", "cell_duplication",
    "cell_wrong_value", "thread_loss", "thread_duplication",
    "no_cell", "no_thread", "contradictory_pre",
)
VARIANTS = POSITIVES + NEGATIVES


def require(ok: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(reason)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def extract_braced_item(source: bytes, signature: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(source.count(signature) == 1,
            f"source item is absent or ambiguous: {signature.decode()}")
    at = source.index(signature) + len(signature)
    opening = source.find(b"{", at)
    require(opening >= 0, "source item body is absent")
    depth = 0
    for cursor in range(opening, len(source)):
        if source[cursor] == ord("{"):
            depth += 1
        elif source[cursor] == ord("}"):
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[opening:cursor + 1]
    raise ValueError("source item body is unterminated")


def source_certificate(repo: Path) -> dict:
    values = {}
    for relative, expected in SOURCE_SHA.items():
        value = (repo / relative).read_bytes()
        require(digest(value) == expected,
                f"pinned std source changed: {relative}")
        values[relative] = value
    forget = extract_braced_item(values["library/core/src/mem/mod.rs"],
                                 FORGET_SIGNATURE)
    md = extract_braced_item(values["library/core/src/mem/manually_drop.rs"],
                             MD_SIGNATURE)
    require(forget == FORGET_BODY, "exact forget body changed")
    require(md == MD_BODY, "direct-field ManuallyDrop::new changed")
    return {
        "source_sha256": SOURCE_SHA,
        "forget_signature": FORGET_SIGNATURE.decode(),
        "forget_body_sha256": digest(forget),
        "manually_drop_new_body_sha256": digest(md),
        "source_exact": True,
        "tool_profile": "VF26.10 plus independently accepted CFG/S6 components",
        "proof_status": "NOT_RUN",
        "trusted_boundary": "ManuallyDrop identity and destructor suppression",
        "actual_call_redirect": False,
    }


def ghost(clauses: bytes) -> bytes:
    lines = clauses.splitlines()
    require(len(lines) == 3 and
            lines[0].startswith(b"req ") and
            lines[1].startswith(b"ens ") and
            lines[2].startswith(b"on_unwind_ens ") and
            all(line.endswith(b";") for line in lines),
            "contract must have separate complete req/ens/unwind clauses")
    return b"".join(b"/*@\n" + line + b"\n@*/\n" for line in lines)


def strip_ghost(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    data = re.sub(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/(?:\r?\n)?", b"", data, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*//@[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)", b"", data)


def helper(variant: str, annotated: bool) -> bytes:
    post = b"thread_token(tid)"
    if variant == "thread_loss":
        post = b"true"
    elif variant == "thread_duplication":
        post += b" &*& thread_token(tid)"
    contract = ghost(b"req thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread;\n"
                     b"ens " + post + b";\non_unwind_ens false;")
    if not annotated:
        contract = strip_ghost(contract)
    return (b"unsafe fn checked_forget_generic<T>(t: T)\n" + contract +
            FORGET_BODY + b"\n")


def probe(variant: str, annotated: bool) -> bytes:
    two = variant == "two_frames"
    pre = b"thread_token(?tid) &*& tid == currentThread"
    if variant == "no_thread":
        pre = b"true"
    if variant == "contradictory_pre":
        pre += b" &*& false"
    if variant != "no_cell":
        pre += b" &*& *slot |-> ?value"
    pre += b" &*& *frame |-> ?flag"
    if two:
        pre += b" &*& *frame2 |-> ?flag2"

    post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& *slot |-> value &*& *frame |-> flag"
    if variant == "no_cell":
        post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& *slot |-> _ &*& *frame |-> flag"
    if variant == "no_thread":
        post = b"thread_token(?restored) &*& *slot |-> value &*& *frame |-> flag"
    if two:
        post += b" &*& *frame2 |-> flag2"
    if variant == "false_post":
        post += b" &*& false"
    elif variant == "frame_loss":
        post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& *slot |-> value"
    elif variant == "frame_duplication":
        post += b" &*& *frame |-> flag"
    elif variant == "frame_wrong_value":
        post = (b"thread_token(tid) &*& *slot |-> value &*& "
                b"*frame |-> ?changed &*& changed != flag")
    elif variant == "cell_loss":
        post = b"thread_token(tid) &*& *frame |-> flag"
    elif variant == "cell_duplication":
        post += b" &*& *slot |-> value"
    elif variant == "cell_wrong_value":
        post = (b"thread_token(tid) &*& *slot |-> ?changed &*& "
                b"changed != value &*& *frame |-> flag")

    contract = ghost(b"req " + pre + b";\nens " + post +
                     b";\non_unwind_ens false;")
    if not annotated:
        contract = strip_ghost(contract)
    # The two positive frame obligations use the exact forget runtime body
    # in this function.  Calling the separate checked helper would leave a
    # synthetic `unwind=continue` successor which VeriFast's mandatory
    # dead-code gate rejects even when its false-unwind contract is proved.
    # The call linkage is a distinct, still-open obligation.
    if variant in POSITIVES:
        body = FORGET_BODY + b"\n"
    else:
        body = b"{\n    unsafe { checked_forget_generic(t); }\n"
        if variant == "assert_false" and annotated:
            body += b"    //@ assert false;\n"
        body += b"}\n"
    extra = b", frame2: *mut bool" if two else b""
    # Public entry permits an external caller to rely on this proved contract.
    return (b"pub unsafe fn checked_forget_frame_probe<T, Element>(\n"
            b"    t: T, slot: *mut *const Element, frame: *mut bool" + extra +
            b"\n)\n" + contract + body)


def fixture(variant: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown forget/frame variant")
    header = b"use std::mem::ManuallyDrop;\n\n"
    if variant in POSITIVES:
        # Keep the independently proved generic callee in the negative/call
        # fixtures.  An uncalled private callee here would itself be rejected
        # by the mandatory dead-code gate.
        verified = header + probe(variant, True)
        original = header + probe(variant, False)
    else:
        verified = header + helper(variant, True) + b"\n" + probe(variant, True)
        original = header + helper(variant, False) + b"\n" + probe(variant, False)
    require(strip_ghost(verified) == original,
            "ghost stripping changed runtime fixture")
    body_count = 1
    call_count = 0 if variant in POSITIVES else 1
    require(original.count(FORGET_BODY) == body_count and
            original.count(b"checked_forget_generic(t)") == call_count,
            "exact generic forget body/call inventory changed")
    return original, verified, {
        "variant": variant,
        "expected": "full verifier PASS" if variant in POSITIVES
                    else "named proof/leak/dead-code negative",
        "expected_failure": {
            "false_post": "probe postcondition false",
            "assert_false": "probe body assertion false",
            "frame_loss": "probe leak of frame",
            "frame_duplication": "probe postcondition duplicate frame",
            "frame_wrong_value": "probe postcondition changed frame value",
            "cell_loss": "probe leak of initialized slot",
            "cell_duplication": "probe postcondition duplicate slot",
            "cell_wrong_value": "probe postcondition changed slot pointer",
            "thread_loss": "helper leak of thread token",
            "thread_duplication": "helper postcondition duplicate token",
            "no_cell": "probe postcondition missing initialized slot",
            "no_thread": "probe call precondition missing thread token",
            "contradictory_pre": "mandatory dead-code gate",
        }.get(variant),
        "normal_post_preserves": ["thread", "initialized pointer slot", "frame"],
        "unwind_post": "false",
        "generic_argument": "unrestricted sized T",
        "element_rights": False,
        "actual_call_redirect": False,
        "positive_is_direct_body_frame_proof": variant in POSITIVES,
        "separate_call_linkage_proved": False,
        "original_sha256": digest(original),
        "verified_sha256": digest(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
    }


def write_case(repo: Path, out: Path, variant: str) -> dict:
    source = source_certificate(repo)
    original, verified, case = fixture(variant)
    require(not out.exists(), f"refusing to overwrite {out}")
    (out / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / "verified").mkdir()
    (out / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (out / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {"source_certificate": source, **case}
    (out / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2,
                                                  sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return record


def main() -> None:
    require(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted",
            "fixture generation is permitted only on GitHub-hosted Actions")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=VARIANTS, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(write_case(args.repo, args.out, args.variant),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hosted-only 26.10 strict lifetime-cut regression capture.

All results are diagnostic until the complete source/MIR/kernel review and
combined-profile regressions described in MATRIX.md have passed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TEMPLATE = HERE / "cases.rs"
EXPECTED_TEMPLATE_SHA256 = "7cb5c8a8a2541da30af188c8731ee13276c59b206e5ed58a78e909852719359e"
POSITIVE = ("positive_basic", "ordinary_unmarked",
            "positive_early_return", "positive_direct_unwind",
            "positive_f_bound")
NEGATIVE = (
    "negative_wrong_marker", "negative_duplicate_marker",
    "negative_marker_outside_binding", "negative_unknown_binding",
    "negative_nested_marker", "negative_malformed_marker",
    "negative_type_name_after_cut", "negative_type_argument_after_cut",
    "negative_typed_chunk_survives_cut", "negative_unclosed_fractional_access",
    "negative_reserved_half_after_lifetime_end", "negative_end_lifetime_twice",
)
ALL = POSITIVE + NEGATIVE
BLOCK_COMMENT = re.compile(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/(?:\r?\n)?", re.S)
LINE_COMMENT = re.compile(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*//@[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)")
CASE_BEGIN = re.compile(rb"(?m)^// CASE_BEGIN ([a-z0-9_]+)\r?\n")


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def need(ok: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def strip_ghost(source: bytes) -> bytes:
    return LINE_COMMENT.sub(b"", BLOCK_COMMENT.sub(b"", source))


def target_name(case: str) -> str:
    # The accepted callback hook admits only this exact local DefPath.
    return "callback_positive" if case == "positive_f_bound" else case


def select_case(template: bytes, name: str) -> bytes:
    matches = list(CASE_BEGIN.finditer(template))
    need(len(matches) == len(ALL) and
         {m.group(1).decode() for m in matches} == set(ALL),
         "lifetime case inventory changed")
    matches = [m for m in matches if m.group(1).decode() == name]
    need(len(matches) == 1, "selected lifetime case is not unique")
    marker = matches[0]
    close = b"// CASE_END " + name.encode()
    end = template.find(close, marker.end())
    need(end >= 0 and template.find(close, end + 1) == -1,
         "selected lifetime case has no unique end")
    header = template[:CASE_BEGIN.search(template).start()]
    body = template[marker.end():end]
    need(b"// CASE_BEGIN " not in body and b"// CASE_END " not in body,
         "selected lifetime case contains another case")
    verified = header + body
    generic_targets = {"positive_f_bound", "negative_typed_chunk_survives_cut"}
    target = (b"pub unsafe fn " + target_name(name).encode() +
              (b"<" if name in generic_targets else b"("))
    need(verified.count(target) == 1, "target function source shape changed")
    expected_count = 2 if name == "positive_direct_unwind" else 1
    need(verified.count(b"pub unsafe fn ") == expected_count,
         "selected lifetime case has unexpected callee bodies")
    expected_markers = (0 if name == "ordinary_unmarked" else
                        2 if name == "negative_duplicate_marker" else 1)
    need(verified.count(b"end_lft_binding::") == expected_markers,
         "selected lifetime case has unexpected cut marker inventory")
    return verified


def balanced_mir_item(source: str, start: int) -> str:
    need(source[start:start + 1] == "(", "MIR body must start with '('")
    depth = 0
    quoted = False
    escaped = False
    for index in range(start, len(source)):
        char = source[index]
        if quoted:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif char == '"':
                quoted = False
        elif char == '"':
            quoted = True
        elif char == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[start:index + 1]
    raise ValueError("MIR body has no closing parenthesis")


def target_body(decoded: str, name: str) -> str | None:
    marker = f'defPath = "{name}"'
    if decoded.count(marker) != 1:
        return None
    at = decoded.index(marker)
    start = decoded.rfind("    ( defKind =", 0, at)
    if start < 0:
        return None
    body = balanced_mir_item(decoded, decoded.index("(", start))
    return body if marker in body else None


def stage(root: Path, name: str, args: list[str], env: dict[str, str],
          source_hashes: dict[str, str], seconds: int,
          stdin_path: Path | None = None, stdout_path: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    before = {p: sha((root / p).read_bytes()) for p in source_hashes}
    need(before == source_hashes, f"source changed before {name}")
    separate_stderr = stdout_path is not None
    stdout_path = stdout_path or root / f"{name}.log"
    stderr_path = root / f"{name}-stderr.log" if separate_stderr else stdout_path
    with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout:
        with (stderr_path.open("wb") if stderr_path != stdout_path else open(os.devnull, "wb")) as error_output:
            with (stdin_path.open("rb") if stdin_path else open(os.devnull, "rb")) as input_stream:
                started = time.monotonic()
                try:
                    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, env=env, stdin=input_stream,
                                            stdout=stdout,
                                            stderr=(error_output if stderr_path != stdout_path
                                                    else subprocess.STDOUT),
                                            timeout=seconds, check=False)
                    code = result.returncode
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    code = 124
                elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    after = {p: sha((root / p).read_bytes()) for p in source_hashes}
    need(after == source_hashes, f"source changed during {name}")
    return {"exit": code, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
            "source_exact": True, "args": args}


def expected_error(name: str, log: str, code: int) -> bool:
    errors = [line for line in log.splitlines()
              if ": error:" in line or line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    if len(errors) != 1 or code not in (1, 2):
        return False
    error = errors[0]
    if name in ("negative_wrong_marker", "negative_marker_outside_binding",
                "negative_unknown_binding", "negative_nested_marker"):
        return "end_lft_binding needs one enclosing ghost block containing only its let_lft declaration" in error
    if name == "negative_malformed_marker":
        return "end_lft_binding expects exactly one named lifetime type and no arguments" in error
    if name == "negative_duplicate_marker":
        return "Strict lifetime binding expects exactly one cut marker per body" in error
    if name == "negative_typed_chunk_survives_cut":
        return "A lifetime-scoped heap chunk is still live at the binding end" in error
    if name in ("negative_type_name_after_cut", "negative_type_argument_after_cut"):
        return "cmp" in error and any(word in error.lower() for word in
                                      ("no such", "unknown", "unbound", "not in scope", "undeclared"))
    if name in ("negative_unclosed_fractional_access",
                "negative_reserved_half_after_lifetime_end",
                "negative_end_lifetime_twice"):
        return "lifetime_token" in error and "No matching" in error
    return False


def run_case(name: str, template: bytes, tool_home: Path, output: Path,
             sysroot: str, env: dict[str, str], deadline: float,
             opt_in: bool) -> dict:
    env = env.copy()
    if name == "positive_f_bound":
        # This isolated case is the accepted callback-positive protocol with
        # a cut added after its sole call; only this body needs HRTB matching.
        env["SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT"] = "1"
        env["SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT_TARGETS"] = target_name(name)
    else:
        env.pop("SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT", None)
        env.pop("SORT4_HRTB_OUTPUT_TARGETS", None)
    root = output / (name if opt_in else name + "-without-opt-in")
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (root / "original").mkdir()
    (root / "verified").mkdir()
    verified = select_case(template, name)
    original = strip_ghost(verified)
    (root / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    (root / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    hashes = {"verified/lib.rs": sha(verified), "original/lib.rs": sha(original)}
    schema = tool_home / "src/rust_frontend/vf_mir/vf_mir.capnp"
    need(schema.is_file(), "pinned source schema missing")
    stages: dict[str, dict] = {}

    def run(stage_name: str, argv: list[str], cap: int,
            input_name: str | None = None, output_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
        remaining = int(deadline - time.time()) - 15
        if remaining <= 0:
            return {"exit": None, "skipped": "deadline reserve"}
        return stage(root, stage_name, argv, env, hashes, min(cap, remaining),
                     root / input_name if input_name else None,
                     root / output_name if output_name else None)

    exporter = str(tool_home / "bin/vf-rust-mir-exporter")
    for mode, extra in (("normal", []),
                        ("readonly", ["--vf-rust-mir-exporter:preprocess-readonly"])):
        stages[f"{mode}-export"] = run(
            f"{mode}-export", [exporter, "verified/lib.rs", f"--sysroot={sysroot}",
                                "--edition", "2021", "--crate-type", "lib", *extra],
            90, output_name=f"{mode}-mir.bin")
        if stages[f"{mode}-export"]["exit"] == 0:
            stages[f"{mode}-decode"] = run(
                f"{mode}-decode", ["capnp", "decode", str(schema), "VfMir"],
                60, input_name=f"{mode}-mir.bin", output_name=f"{mode}-mir.txt")
        else:
            stages[f"{mode}-decode"] = {"exit": None, "skipped": "export failure"}

    stages["full-verification"] = run(
        "full-verification", [str(tool_home / "bin/verifast"),
                              "-rustc_args", "--edition 2021 --crate-type lib",
                              "-verbose", "1", "verified/lib.rs"], 180)
    stages["refinement"] = run(
        "refinement", [str(tool_home / "bin/refinement-checker"),
                       "--rustc-args", "--edition 2021 --crate-type lib",
                       "original/lib.rs", "verified/lib.rs"], 90)

    support = all(stages.get(s, {}).get("exit") == 0 for s in
                  ("normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export",
                   "readonly-decode", "refinement"))
    body_inventory = {}
    for mode in ("normal", "readonly"):
        path = root / f"{mode}-mir.txt"
        mir = path.read_text(errors="replace") if path.is_file() else ""
        names = re.findall(r'defPath = "([^"]+)"', mir)
        selected = target_body(mir, target_name(name))
        body_inventory[mode] = {
            "target_count": names.count(target_name(name)),
            "same_unit_callee_count": names.count("cut_maybe_unwind"),
            "source_path_present": selected is not None and
                                   'localPath = "verified/lib.rs"' in selected,
            "ghost_decl_block_present": selected is not None and
                                        "ghostDeclBlocks = [" in selected,
            "full_decoded_bytes": path.stat().st_size if path.is_file() else 0,
            "full_decoded_sha256": sha(path.read_bytes()) if path.is_file() else None,
            "target_body_sha256": sha(selected.encode()) if selected else None,
        }
    body_audit_ok = all(row["target_count"] == 1 and
                        row["same_unit_callee_count"] ==
                        (1 if name == "positive_direct_unwind" else 0) and
                        row["source_path_present"] and
                        row["ghost_decl_block_present"]
                        for row in body_inventory.values())
    log_path = root / "full-verification.log"
    log = log_path.read_text(errors="replace") if log_path.exists() else ""
    code = stages["full-verification"]["exit"]
    named = log.count(f"Verifying function '{target_name(name)}'")
    callee = log.count("Verifying function 'cut_maybe_unwind'")
    direct_unwind = True
    if name == "positive_direct_unwind":
        direct_unwind = all("name = \"cut_maybe_unwind\"" in
                            (root / f"{mode}-mir.txt").read_text(errors="replace") and
                            "unwindAction = (continue = void)" in
                            (root / f"{mode}-mir.txt").read_text(errors="replace")
                            for mode in ("normal", "readonly")
                            if (root / f"{mode}-mir.txt").is_file())
    status = "INCONCLUSIVE"
    if support and body_audit_ok and not opt_in and name == "positive_basic" and \
            code in (1, 2) and len([line for line in log.splitlines()
                                     if "Strict lifetime binding requires explicit overnight opt-in" in line]) == 1:
        status = "OPT_IN_ABSENT_INTENDED_REJECTION_CANDIDATE"
    if support and body_audit_ok and name in POSITIVE and code == 0 and named == 1 and \
            (name != "positive_direct_unwind" or (callee == 1 and direct_unwind)):
        status = "POSITIVE_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
    if support and body_audit_ok and name in NEGATIVE and expected_error(name, log, code):
        status = "INTENDED_NEGATIVE_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
    result = {
        "case": name, "classification": status, "stages": stages,
        "strict_lifetime_opt_in": opt_in,
        "source_hashes": hashes, "source_strip_identity": strip_ghost(verified) == original,
        "normal_post": (
            "thread/type resources, both T cells/owners, comparator F cell/owner"
            if name == "positive_f_bound" else
            "full lifetime token returned" if name in POSITIVE else
            "negative fixture's stated contract"),
        "unwind_post": (
            "thread/type resources, both T cells/owners, comparator F cell/owner"
            if name == "positive_f_bound" else
            "full lifetime token returned on direct unwind"
            if name == "positive_direct_unwind" else "fixture-specific"),
        "target_headers": named, "callee_headers": callee,
        "decoded_body_inventory": body_inventory,
        "decoded_body_inventory_ok": body_audit_ok,
        "direct_unwind_mir_candidate": direct_unwind,
        "full_error_lines": [line for line in log.splitlines()
                             if ": error:" in line or line.startswith("Fatal error:")],
        "accepted": False,
    }
    (root / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=float, default=time.time() + 1800)
    parser.add_argument("--case", choices=ALL, action="append")
    parser.add_argument("--without-opt-in", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(os.getenv("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
         os.getenv("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted" and
         os.getenv("RUNNER_OS") == "Linux", "hosted GitHub Linux required")
    need(not args.out.exists(), "evidence directory must be fresh")
    args.out.mkdir(parents=True)
    need(args.tool_home.is_dir(), "source-built VeriFast home missing")
    for path in ("bin/verifast", "bin/vf-rust-mir-exporter", "bin/refinement-checker"):
        need((args.tool_home / path).is_file(), f"missing tool {path}")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN"] = "nightly-2026-09-25"
    if args.without_opt_in:
        env.pop("SORT4_STRICT_LFT_CUT", None)
    else:
        env["SORT4_STRICT_LFT_CUT"] = "1"
    env["PATH"] = str(args.tool_home / "bin") + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
    compiler = subprocess.run(["rustc", "--print", "sysroot"], env=env,
                              check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    sysroot = compiler.stdout.strip()
    template = TEMPLATE.read_bytes()
    need(sha(template) == EXPECTED_TEMPLATE_SHA256,
         "lifetime source template differs from reviewed bytes")
    cases = args.case or list(ALL)
    need(not args.without_opt_in or cases == ["positive_basic"],
         "without-opt-in control requires only --case positive_basic")
    results = [run_case(name, template, args.tool_home, args.out, sysroot,
                        env, args.deadline_epoch, not args.without_opt_in)
               for name in cases]
    summary = {"classification": "DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_UNTIL_REVIEW",
               "patch_sha256": sha((HERE / "verifast-strict-lft-cut-26.10.patch").read_bytes()),
               "template_sha256": sha(template), "cases": results}
    (args.out / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
    need(all(r["classification"] != "INCONCLUSIVE" for r in results),
         "one or more lifetime-cut cases are inconclusive")


if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hosted diagnostic: link two actual MaybeUninit::new calls to checked S6 body.

This is constructor linkage only. Later actual helper operations remain unmodeled.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path


def require(ok: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(reason)


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def load(path: Path, name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None,
            f"cannot import {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = HERE.parents[2]
CONSTRUCTOR = load(REPO / "research/challenge-8/overnight-s6/check-maybeuninit-new-pointer.py",
                   "overnight_constructor_linkage_source")
ACTUAL = load(REPO / "research/challenge-8/overnight-helper/prepare-actual-helper-capture.py",
              "overnight_actual_linkage_source")
VARIANTS = ("positive", "wrong_active_field", "extra_union_field")
MODULE_MARKER = b"mod sort4_certified_maybeuninit"
ACTUAL_MARKER = b"pub fn select_unpredictable<Element>("
ERR = re.compile(r"^(.+?)\((\d+),([^)]*)\): error: (.*)$", re.M)


def write_json(path: Path, data) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def source_hashes(case: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {relative: sha((case / relative).read_bytes()) for relative in
            ("original/lib.rs", "verified/lib.rs")}


def make_case(baseline_verified: bytes, body: bytes, cert: dict,
              case: Path, variant: str) -> dict:
    require(variant in VARIANTS, f"unknown variant: {variant}")
    _, source, component = CONSTRUCTOR.constructor_source(cert, variant)
    union_body = CONSTRUCTOR.extract_braced_item(source, MODULE_MARKER)
    module = MODULE_MARKER + b" " + union_body + b"\n"
    require(source.count(module) == 1,
            "local constructor module differs from S6 source builder")
    verified = CONSTRUCTOR.enable_crate_feature(
        baseline_verified, b"transparent_unions")
    require(verified.count(ACTUAL_MARKER) == 1 and
            verified.count(body) == 1 and verified.count(MODULE_MARKER) == 0,
            "actual helper source has changed or already contains adapter")
    verified = verified.replace(ACTUAL_MARKER, module + b"\n" + ACTUAL_MARKER, 1)
    original = CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified)
    require(CONSTRUCTOR.strip_ghost_annotations(verified) == original and
            verified.count(body) == original.count(body) == 1 and
            original.count(b"crate::mem::forget(guard);") == 1,
            "auxiliary linkage changed actual runtime body or ghost strip")
    require(not case.exists(), f"refusing overwrite: {case}")
    (case / "original").mkdir(parents=True)
    (case / "verified").mkdir()
    (case / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (case / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    record = {
        "variant": variant,
        "actual_body_sha256": sha(body),
        "actual_body_byte_identical": True,
        "actual_new_call_count": body.count(b"MaybeUninit::new("),
        "local_module_sha256": sha(module),
        "local_module_source_variant": component["variant"],
        "original_sha256": sha(original),
        "verified_sha256": sha(verified),
        "ghost_strip_identity": True,
        "scope": "constructor linkage only; actual helper not proved",
    }
    require(record["actual_new_call_count"] == 2,
            "actual constructor call count changed")
    write_json(case / "fixture.json", record)
    return record


def stage(case: Path, name: str, command: list[str], args,
          *, input_name: str | None = None, output_name: str | None = None,
          env_constructor: bool = False, cap_seconds: int = 90) -> dict:
    remaining = int(args.deadline_epoch - time.time()) - 25
    if remaining < 8:
        record = {"status": "NOT_RUN_DEADLINE", "exit": None,
                  "source_unchanged": None}
        write_json(case / f"{name}-stage.json", record)
        return record
    before = source_hashes(case)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for key in ("SORT4_MAYBEUNINIT_REPO_ROOT",
                "SORT4_SELECT_INTRINSIC_REPO_ROOT",
                "SORT4_POINTER_DROP_REPO_ROOT"):
        env.pop(key, None)
    if env_constructor:
        env["SORT4_MAYBEUNINIT_REPO_ROOT"] = str(REPO)
    env["PATH"] = str(args.tool_home / "bin") + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
    stdout = case / (output_name or f"{name}.log")
    stderr = case / f"{name}-stderr.log" if output_name else stdout
    timeout = max(8, min(cap_seconds, remaining))
    with (case / input_name).open("rb") if input_name else open(os.devnull, "rb") as inp:
        with stdout.open("wb") as out:
            if stderr == stdout:
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ["timeout", "--signal=TERM", "--kill-after=10s",
                     f"{timeout}s", *command], cwd=case, stdin=inp,
                    stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, check=False)
            else:
                with stderr.open("wb") as err:
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        ["timeout", "--signal=TERM", "--kill-after=10s",
                         f"{timeout}s", *command], cwd=case, stdin=inp,
                        stdout=out, stderr=err, env=env, check=False)
    after = source_hashes(case)
    record = {"status": "RAN" if result.returncode != 124 else "TIMED_OUT",
              "exit": result.returncode, "argv": command,
              "constructor_gate_active": env_constructor,
              "source_unchanged": before == after,
              "source_before": before, "source_after": after,
              "stdout": stdout.name, "stderr": stderr.name}
    write_json(case / f"{name}-stage.json", record)
    return record


def run_case(case: Path, args) -> dict:
    exporter = str(args.tool_home / "bin/vf-rust-mir-exporter")
    stages = {}
    stages["normal-export"] = stage(case, "normal-export", [
        exporter, "verified/lib.rs", f"--sysroot={args.compiler_sysroot}",
        "--edition", "2021"], args, output_name="normal-mir.bin")
    stages["readonly-export"] = stage(case, "readonly-export", [
        exporter, "verified/lib.rs", f"--sysroot={args.compiler_sysroot}",
        "--edition", "2021", "--crate-type", "lib",
        "--vf-rust-mir-exporter:preprocess-readonly"], args,
        output_name="readonly-mir.bin")
    for mode in ("normal", "readonly"):
        if stages[f"{mode}-export"]["exit"] == 0:
            stages[f"{mode}-decode"] = stage(case, f"{mode}-decode", [
                "capnp", "decode", str(args.schema), "VfMir"], args,
                input_name=f"{mode}-mir.bin", output_name=f"{mode}-mir.txt",
                cap_seconds=40)
    four = all(stages.get(k, {}).get("exit") == 0 for k in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export", "readonly-decode"))
    if four:
        stages["full-verification"] = stage(case, "full-verification", [
            str(args.tool_home / "bin/verifast"), "-rustc_args",
            "--edition 2021", "-verbose", "1", "verified/lib.rs"], args,
            env_constructor=True, cap_seconds=100)
        stages["refinement"] = stage(case, "refinement", [
            str(args.tool_home / "bin/refinement-checker"), "--rustc-args",
            "--edition 2021", "original/lib.rs", "verified/lib.rs"], args,
            cap_seconds=70)
    return stages


def classify(case: Path, variant: str, stages: dict) -> dict:
    complete = all(stages.get(k, {}).get("exit") == 0 for k in (
        "normal-export", "normal-decode", "readonly-export",
        "readonly-decode", "refinement"))
    intact = all(item.get("source_unchanged") is True for item in stages.values())
    log = (case / "full-verification.log").read_text(errors="replace") if \
        (case / "full-verification.log").exists() else ""
    errors = ERR.findall(log)
    fatal = [line for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    result = {"variant": variant, "classification": "INCONCLUSIVE",
              "frontend_refinement": complete, "source_integrity": intact,
              "full_verifier_exit": stages.get("full-verification", {}).get("exit"),
              "first_error": errors[0] if errors else None,
              "fatal": fatal, "stages": stages}
    if variant == "positive":
        constructor_name = "sort4_certified_maybeuninit::sort4_checked_maybeuninit_new"
        start = log.find("Verifying function '" + constructor_name + "'")
        end = log.find("Verifying function 'select_unpredictable'", start + 1)
        constructor_log = log[start:end] if start >= 0 and end > start else ""
        checks = {
            "certified_source_and_full_mir": log.count(
                "SORT4-MAYBEUNINIT: certified local body " + constructor_name) == 1,
            "first_actual_call_redirected": log.count(
                "SORT4-MAYBEUNINIT: redirected checked external pointer call 1") == 1,
            "second_actual_call_redirected": log.count(
                "SORT4-MAYBEUNINIT: redirected checked external pointer call 2") == 1,
            "exact_two_call_count": "redirected=2, expected=2" in log,
            "local_constructor_proved": "Executing return statement" in constructor_log and
                "Leak check." in constructor_log,
            "actual_body_entered": end > start,
            "old_missing_new_error_gone": "No such function: std::mem::MaybeUninit::<T>::new" not in log,
            "no_certificate_fatal": not fatal,
            "next_blocker_after_linkage": bool(errors) and
                "No such function: std::mem::MaybeUninit::<T>::as_mut_ptr" in errors[0][3],
        }
        result["checks"] = checks
        if complete and intact and stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 1 and \
                all(checks.values()) and len(errors) == 1:
            result["classification"] = "CONSTRUCTOR_LINKED_DIAGNOSTIC"
    else:
        reason = ("local constructor runtime body differs from repository"
                  if variant == "wrong_active_field" else
                  "certified union fields or types differ")
        checks = {"exact_certificate_reason": len(fatal) == 1 and
                  fatal[0] == ("Fatal error: exception Failure(\"SORT4-MAYBEUNINIT: "
                               "certificate mismatch: " + reason + "\")"),
                  "no_function_proof": "Verifying function '" not in log,
                  "no_proof_error": not errors}
        result["checks"] = checks
        if complete and intact and stages["full-verification"]["exit"] == 2 and \
                all(checks.values()):
            result["classification"] = "INTENDED_SOURCE_CERTIFICATE_REJECTION"
    write_json(case / "classification.json", result)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    require(os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "github-hosted" and
            os.environ.get("RUNNER_OS") == "Linux",
            "constructor linkage is hosted-only")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-home", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sysroot", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--deadline-epoch", type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    evidence = args.evidence.resolve()
    require(not evidence.exists(), f"refusing overwrite: {evidence}")
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
    baseline_dir = evidence / "baseline-capture"
    baseline = ACTUAL.write_fixture(REPO, baseline_dir)
    actual_body, actual_cert = ACTUAL.source_certificate(REPO)
    constructor_cert = CONSTRUCTOR.certify_repository_sources(REPO)
    baseline_verified = (baseline_dir / "verified/lib.rs").read_bytes()
    results = []
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        case = evidence / variant
        try:
            fixture = make_case(baseline_verified, actual_body,
                                constructor_cert, case, variant)
            stages = run_case(case, args)
            outcome = classify(case, variant, stages)
            outcome["fixture"] = fixture
        except Exception as exc:
            outcome = {"variant": variant, "classification": "INCONCLUSIVE",
                       "harness_exception": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
        results.append(outcome)
        print(json.dumps({"variant": variant,
                          "classification": outcome["classification"]}), flush=True)
    accepted = (len(results) == len(VARIANTS) and
                results[0]["classification"] == "CONSTRUCTOR_LINKED_DIAGNOSTIC" and
                all(item["classification"] == "INTENDED_SOURCE_CERTIFICATE_REJECTION"
                    for item in results[1:]))
    summary = {"classification": "CONSTRUCTOR_LINKAGE_ACCEPTED" if accepted else
               "INCONCLUSIVE", "accepted_component": accepted,
               "actual_helper_proved": False,
               "actual_body_sha256": sha(actual_body),
               "actual_source_certificate": actual_cert,
               "constructor_source_certificate": constructor_cert,
               "baseline_capture": baseline, "results": results}
    write_json(evidence / "summary.json", summary)
    if not accepted:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
"""Prepare and check the narrowly certified MaybeUninit constructor profile.

All compilation, MIR export/decode, VeriFast, and refinement work is guarded
for GitHub-hosted Linux Actions. This script only prepares disposable fixtures;
it never edits repository Rust sources.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path


HINT_SHA256 = "ce89716d46b8060db2c2da1aef1d4bcccf90e0804fc021d4470c55203501315f"
HINT_BLOB = "8d7c2a16899e19b8a7e31e540478138eaac169b9"
MAYBE_UNINIT_SHA256 = "1230d267542337ee2842c29d8227cf8a58fe75c53a2a70efaee3922c4e8e25c0"
MANUALLY_DROP_SHA256 = "f9cce798828cc852c00feeea9a6218c225b68d92727a5edbddc7c08a731a4f25"
MAYBE_DANGLING_SHA256 = "0e1ec6f588f2c314751054b39c73d19517eb1fd03e31e7865c95813c389d1182"

SELECT_SCRIPT = "prepare-and-check-sort4-select.py"
CERT_MODULE = "sort4_certified_maybeuninit"
CERT_FUNCTION = "sort4_checked_maybeuninit_new"
CERT_FUNCTION_PATH = f"{CERT_MODULE}::{CERT_FUNCTION}"
CERT_DIAGNOSTIC = "SORT4-MAYBEUNINIT:"
RUST_SOURCE_NEW_CALL = b"MaybeUninit::new("
MIR_EXTERNAL_NEW = b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::<T>::new"
UNION_SIGNATURE = b"pub union MaybeUninit<T>"
NEW_SIGNATURE = b"pub const fn new(val: T) -> MaybeUninit<T>"
EXPECTED_NEW_BODY = b"{\n        MaybeUninit { value: ManuallyDrop::new(val) }\n    }"
INTRINSIC_SELECT = b"crate::intrinsics::select_unpredictable("


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def strict_proof_negative(evidence: dict[str, bool]) -> bool:
    """Accept a negative only after the named proof obligation was reached."""
    required = (
        "proof_expected", "integrity_and_frontend_ok", "verifier_failed",
        "target_obligation", "intended_message", "no_applicability_rejection",
        "named_probe_entered", "error_in_named_probe", "constructor_body_checked",
        "external_call_count_exact", "redirect_count_exact",
    )
    return all(evidence.get(key) is True for key in required)


def exact_certificate_failure(log: str, reason: str) -> bool:
    fatal = [line for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith("Fatal error:")]
    return fatal == [
        f'Fatal error: exception Failure("SORT4-MAYBEUNINIT: certificate mismatch: {reason}")'
    ]


def strict_applicability_negative(evidence: dict[str, bool]) -> bool:
    required = (
        "integrity_and_frontend_ok", "verifier_exit_is_certificate_failure",
        "exact_case_reason", "no_constructor_proof", "no_probe_proof",
        "mutation_integrity_ok",
    )
    return all(evidence.get(key) is True for key in required)


def extract_braced_item(source: bytes, signature: bytes) -> bytes:
    require(source.count(signature) == 1,
            f"expected one source item signature: {signature.decode('ascii')}")
    start = source.index(signature)
    opening = source.find(b"{", start + len(signature))
    require(opening >= 0, "source item has no opening brace")
    depth = 0
    state = "code"
    block_depth = 0
    i = opening
    while i < len(source):
        byte = source[i]
        nxt = source[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(source) else 0
        if state == "line":
            if byte == 10:
                state = "code"
        elif state == "block":
            if byte == 47 and nxt == 42:
                block_depth += 1
                i += 1
            elif byte == 42 and nxt == 47:
                block_depth -= 1
                i += 1
                if block_depth == 0:
                    state = "code"
        elif state == "string":
            if byte == 92:
                i += 1
            elif byte == 34:
                state = "code"
        elif state == "char":
            if byte == 92:
                i += 1
            elif byte == 39:
                state = "code"
        elif byte == 47 and nxt == 47:
            state = "line"
            i += 1
        elif byte == 47 and nxt == 42:
            state = "block"
            block_depth = 1
            i += 1
        elif byte == 34:
            state = "string"
        elif byte == 39:
            closing = source.find(b"'", i + 1, min(len(source), i + 10))
            if closing >= 0:
                state = "char"
        elif byte == 123:
            depth += 1
        elif byte == 125:
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return source[opening:i + 1]
        i += 1
    raise ValueError("unterminated source item")


def load_select_module(repo_root: Path):
    path = Path(__file__).with_name(SELECT_SCRIPT)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("sort4_select_prepare", path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError("could not load the existing select fixture preparer")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def certify_repository_sources(repo_root: Path) -> dict:
    paths = {
        "hint": repo_root / "library/core/src/hint.rs",
        "maybe_uninit": repo_root / "library/core/src/mem/maybe_uninit.rs",
        "manually_drop": repo_root / "library/core/src/mem/manually_drop.rs",
        "maybe_dangling": repo_root / "library/core/src/mem/maybe_dangling.rs",
    }
    contents = {key: path.read_bytes() for key, path in paths.items()}
    expected = {
        "hint": HINT_SHA256,
        "maybe_uninit": MAYBE_UNINIT_SHA256,
        "manually_drop": MANUALLY_DROP_SHA256,
        "maybe_dangling": MAYBE_DANGLING_SHA256,
    }
    actual = {key: sha(value) for key, value in contents.items()}
    for key in expected:
        require(actual[key] == expected[key],
                f"pinned {key} source SHA-256 mismatch: {actual[key]}")
    hint_blob = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "hash-object", str(paths["hint"])],
        text=True,
    ).strip()
    require(hint_blob == HINT_BLOB, f"pinned hint.rs blob mismatch: {hint_blob}")

    hint_body = load_select_module(repo_root).extract_body(contents["hint"])
    require(hint_body.count(INTRINSIC_SELECT) == 3,
            "pinned select body must retain exactly three intrinsics")
    require(hint_body.count(RUST_SOURCE_NEW_CALL) == 2,
            "pinned select body must retain exactly two MaybeUninit::new calls")

    union = extract_braced_item(contents["maybe_uninit"], UNION_SIGNATURE)
    new_body = extract_braced_item(contents["maybe_uninit"], NEW_SIGNATURE)
    manually_drop = extract_braced_item(
        contents["manually_drop"], b"pub struct ManuallyDrop<T: ?Sized>")
    require(union == b"{\n    uninit: (),\n    value: ManuallyDrop<T>,\n}",
            "pinned MaybeUninit union field definition changed")
    require(new_body == EXPECTED_NEW_BODY,
            "pinned MaybeUninit::new body changed")
    require(manually_drop == b"{\n    value: T,\n}",
            "pinned ManuallyDrop direct payload field changed")
    return {
        "repository_root": str(repo_root),
        "files": {
            key: {"path": str(paths[key]), "sha256": actual[key]}
            for key in paths
        },
        "hint_git_blob": hint_blob,
        "hint_body_sha256": sha(hint_body),
        "hint_intrinsic_call_count": hint_body.count(INTRINSIC_SELECT),
        "hint_external_maybeuninit_new_call_count": hint_body.count(RUST_SOURCE_NEW_CALL),
        "external_mir_constructor_def_path": MIR_EXTERNAL_NEW.decode("ascii"),
        "union_item_sha256": sha(union),
        "constructor_body_sha256": sha(new_body),
        "manually_drop_direct_payload_sha256": sha(manually_drop),
        "constructor_body_exact": True,
        "union_fields_exact": True,
        "manuallydrop_direct_payload_certified": True,
        "maybedangling_source_pinned_but_not_used_by_manuallydrop": True,
        "exported_def_id_limitation": (
            "MIR exporter serializes def_path_str only; this source/MIR certificate "
            "is an explicit local-copy applicability link, not DefId equality"
        ),
    }


def ghost_block(contract: bytes) -> bytes:
    clauses = []
    current = []
    pending_comments = []
    for line in contract.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith((b"req ", b"ens ", b"on_unwind_ens ")):
            if current:
                clauses.append(current)
            current = pending_comments + [line]
            pending_comments = []
        elif stripped.startswith(b"// TARGET_"):
            pending_comments.append(line)
        elif current:
            current.append(line)
        elif stripped:
            pending_comments.append(line)
    if current:
        clauses.append(current)
    require(not pending_comments, "ghost marker/comment is not attached to a contract clause")
    require(bool(clauses), "empty ghost contract")
    return b"\n" + b"\n".join(
        b"/*@\n" + b"\n".join(clause) + b"\n@*/" for clause in clauses
    ) + b"\n"


def enable_crate_feature(source: bytes, feature: bytes) -> bytes:
    line = b"#![feature(" + feature + b")]"
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    if any(existing.rstrip(b"\r\n") == line for existing in lines[:16]):
        return source
    insert_at = 0
    for index, existing in enumerate(lines):
        if existing.startswith(b"#!["):
            insert_at = index + 1
        else:
            break
    lines.insert(insert_at, line + b"\n")
    return b"".join(lines)


def strip_ghost_annotations(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    data = re.sub(rb"/\*@.*?@\*/", b"", data, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(rb"(?m)^[ \t]*//@[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)", b"", data)


def constructor_source(cert: dict, variant: str = "positive") -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict]:
    maybe_source = (Path(cert["files"]["maybe_uninit"]["path"])).read_bytes()
    union = extract_braced_item(maybe_source, UNION_SIGNATURE)
    fields = union[1:-1]
    body = extract_braced_item(maybe_source, NEW_SIGNATURE)
    require(body == EXPECTED_NEW_BODY, "constructor body no longer matches pinned expression")

    # The source's manual Copy impl is not part of this constructor proof;
    # pointer instantiation is Copy without adding a local Clone body.
    union_attrs = b"#[repr(transparent)]\n"
    local_union = union_attrs + b"pub union MaybeUninit<T> " + union + b"\n"
    helper_contract = (
        b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread;\n"
        b"ens thread_token(t) &*& "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(result) == some(val) &*& "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(t, result);\n"
        b"on_unwind_ens false;"
    )
    signature = (
        b"pub fn " + CERT_FUNCTION.encode() +
        b"<Element>(val: *const Element) -> MaybeUninit<*const Element>"
    )
    helper_annotation = ghost_block(helper_contract)
    helper_body = body
    if variant == "wrong_active_field":
        helper_body = b"{\n        MaybeUninit { uninit: () }\n    }"
    elif variant in {"wrong_value", "wrong_operand"}:
        helper_body = b"{\n        MaybeUninit { value: ManuallyDrop::new(std::ptr::null::<Element>()) }\n    }"
    elif variant == "wrong_return":
        helper_body = (
            b"{\n        let wrapped = MaybeUninit { value: ManuallyDrop::new(val) };\n"
            b"        wrapped\n    }"
        )
    elif variant == "extra_operation":
        helper_body = (
            b"{\n        std::hint::black_box(val);\n"
            b"        MaybeUninit { value: ManuallyDrop::new(val) }\n    }"
        )

    local_module = (
        b"mod " + CERT_MODULE.encode() + b" {\n"
        b"    use std::mem::ManuallyDrop;\n"
        + local_union
        + b"\n    " + signature + helper_annotation + b"    " + helper_body + b"\n"
        b"}\n"
    )

    # The value being wrapped is deliberately unconstrained as a pointee: no
    # predicate mentions *val.  The two unrelated cells exercise framing.
    probe_contract = (
        b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& "
        b"[?f](*frame |-> ?frame_value) &*& *other |-> ?other_value;\n"
        b"ens thread_token(t) &*& [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& "
        b"*other |-> other_value &*& result == val;\n"
        b"on_unwind_ens false;"
    )
    probe_assert = (
        b"    //@ assert std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(wrapped) == some(val);\n"
        b"    //@ open std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(t, wrapped);\n"
        b"    //@ open raw_ptr_own::<Element>()(t, val);\n"
        b"    //@ close std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(t, "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::new_maybe_uninit(none));\n"
        b"    //@ open std::mem::MaybeUninit_pointer_own::<Element>()(t, "
        b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::new_maybe_uninit(none));\n"
        b"    // TARGET_FRAME_ASSERTION\n"
        b"    //@ assert [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& *other |-> other_value;\n"
    )
    probe_signature = (
        b"pub fn sort4_checked_maybeuninit_frame_probe<Element>(\n"
        b"    val: *const Element, frame: *const u8, other: *mut i32,\n"
        b") -> *const Element\n"
    )
    if variant == "wrong_inner_post":
        probe_signature = (
            b"pub fn sort4_checked_maybeuninit_wrong_value_probe<Element>(\n"
            b"    val: *const Element, wrong: *const Element,\n"
            b"    frame: *const u8, other: *mut i32,\n"
            b") -> *const Element\n"
        )
        probe_contract = (
            b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& "
            b"(val as pointer) != (wrong as pointer) &*& "
            b"[?f](*frame |-> ?frame_value) &*& *other |-> ?other_value;\n"
            b"ens thread_token(t) &*& [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& "
            b"*other |-> other_value &*& result == val;\n"
            b"on_unwind_ens false;"
        )
        probe_assert = (
            b"    // TARGET_ASSERTION\n"
            b"    //@ assert std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(wrapped) == some(wrong);\n"
            b"    //@ assert [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& *other |-> other_value;\n"
        )
    elif variant == "false_assert":
        probe_assert = (
            b"    // TARGET_ASSERTION\n"
            b"    //@ assert false;\n"
            b"    //@ assert [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& *other |-> other_value;\n"
        )
    elif variant == "false_uninit":
        probe_assert = (
            b"    // TARGET_ASSERTION\n"
            b"    //@ assert std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(wrapped) == none;\n"
            b"    //@ assert [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& *other |-> other_value;\n"
        )
    elif variant == "resource_duplication":
        probe_assert = (
            b"    //@ assert std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(wrapped) == some(val);\n"
            b"    // TARGET_ASSERTION\n"
            b"    //@ assert [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& "
            b"[f](*frame |-> frame_value);\n"
        )
    elif variant == "false_postcondition":
        probe_signature = (
            b"pub unsafe fn sort4_checked_maybeuninit_false_post_probe<Element>(\n"
            b"    val: *const Element, wrong: *const Element,\n"
            b"    frame: *const u8, other: *mut i32,\n"
            b") -> *const Element\n"
        )
        probe_contract = (
            b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread &*& "
            b"(val as pointer) != (wrong as pointer) &*& "
            b"[?f](*frame |-> ?frame_value) &*& *other |-> ?other_value;\n"
            b"// TARGET_POSTCONDITION\n"
            b"ens thread_token(t) &*& [f](*frame |-> frame_value) &*& "
            b"*other |-> other_value &*& result == wrong;\n"
            b"on_unwind_ens false;"
        )
        probe_assert = (
            b"    //@ assert std::mem::MaybeUninit::inner(wrapped) == some(val);\n"
            b"    // TARGET_RETURN\n"
        )
    probe_signature = probe_signature.replace(b"pub fn ", b"pub unsafe fn ", 1)
    probe = (
        probe_signature
        + ghost_block(probe_contract)
        + b"{\n"
        b"    let wrapped = std::mem::MaybeUninit::new(val);\n"
        + probe_assert
        + b"    val\n"
        b"}\n"
    )
    if variant == "renamed_function":
        local_module = local_module.replace(
            CERT_FUNCTION.encode(), b"sort4_checked_maybeuninit_new_impostor", 1)
        probe = probe.replace(CERT_FUNCTION.encode(),
                              b"sort4_checked_maybeuninit_new_impostor")
    elif variant == "nonpointer_input":
        local_module = local_module.replace(
            b"<Element>(val: *const Element) -> MaybeUninit<*const Element>",
            b"<Element>(val: Element) -> MaybeUninit<Element>", 1)
    elif variant == "extra_union_field":
        # An extra ZST preserves transparent representation and valid export,
        # so the control reaches the intended exact-field-list certificate.
        local_module = local_module.replace(
            b"    value: ManuallyDrop<T>,\n", b"    value: ManuallyDrop<T>,\n    extra: (),\n", 1)
    elif variant == "wrong_binding":
        probe = probe.replace(
            b"std::mem::MaybeUninit::new(val)",
            b"sort4_certified_maybeuninit::sort4_checked_maybeuninit_new(val)", 1)

    if variant in {"nonpointer_identity", "nonpointer_missing_own"}:
        identity_name = (
            b"sort4_nonpointer_missing_own" if variant == "nonpointer_missing_own"
            else b"sort4_nonpointer_identity"
        )
        own = b"<std::mem::MaybeUninit<i32>>.own"
        identity_pre = (
            b"req thread_token(?t) &*& t == currentThread"
            + (b" &*& " + own + b"(t, input)" if variant == "nonpointer_identity" else b"")
            + b";\n"
        )
        identity_post = (
            b"ens thread_token(t) &*& " + own + b"(t, result) &*& result == input;\n"
            if variant == "nonpointer_identity" else b"ens thread_token(t);\n"
        )
        identity = (
            b"pub fn " + identity_name + b"(\n"
            b"    input: std::mem::MaybeUninit<i32>,\n"
            b") -> std::mem::MaybeUninit<i32>\n"
            + ghost_block(
                identity_pre + identity_post + b"on_unwind_ens false;"
            )
            + b"{\n    input\n}\n"
        )
        probe += b"\n" + identity

    prefix = b"#![feature(transparent_unions)]\n" + local_module + b"\n" + probe
    original_prefix = strip_ghost_annotations(prefix)
    verified_prefix = prefix
    require(strip_ghost_annotations(verified_prefix) == original_prefix,
            "constructor fixture changes runtime source beyond its declared variant")
    fixture_union = extract_braced_item(local_module, UNION_SIGNATURE)
    metadata = {
        "variant": variant,
        "local_function_path_suffix": CERT_FUNCTION_PATH,
        "expected_external_call_count": 1,
        "expected_union_fields": ["uninit: ()", "value: ManuallyDrop<T>"],
        "constructor_runtime_body_sha256": sha(body),
        "fixture_body_sha256": sha(helper_body),
        "fixture_union_fields_sha256": sha(fixture_union[1:-1]),
        "ghost_stripped_equal": True,
        "target_assertion_line": next((i for i, line in enumerate(verified_prefix.splitlines(), 1)
                                        if b"TARGET_ASSERTION" in line), None),
        "target_postcondition_line": next((i for i, line in enumerate(verified_prefix.splitlines(), 1)
                                           if b"TARGET_POSTCONDITION" in line), None),
        "target_return_line": next((i for i, line in enumerate(verified_prefix.splitlines(), 1)
                                     if b"TARGET_RETURN" in line), None),
        "target_opaque_prototype_line": next((i for i, line in enumerate(verified_prefix.splitlines(), 1)
                                            if b") -> std::mem::MaybeUninit<i32>" in line), None),
    }
    return original_prefix, verified_prefix, metadata


def write_case(case_dir: Path, original: bytes, verified: bytes, metadata: dict) -> None:
    stripped = strip_ghost_annotations(verified)
    require(stripped == original,
            f"{case_dir.name}: original/verified runtime sources differ after ghost stripping")
    (case_dir / "original").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (case_dir / "verified").mkdir()
    (case_dir / "original/lib.rs").write_bytes(original)
    (case_dir / "verified/lib.rs").write_bytes(verified)
    metadata["original_sha256"] = sha(original)
    metadata["verified_sha256"] = sha(verified)
    metadata["fixture_runtime_equal_after_ghost_strip"] = stripped == original
    (case_dir / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def file_hashes(paths: tuple[Path, ...], root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {str(path.relative_to(root)): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in paths}
